summary.core_problem: 解决中文矢量字体直接生成中长序列混合组件布局、锚点结构和 Bézier 曲线细节，导致复杂汉字生成困难的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态/结构化生成方法。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但把非自然语言的矢量图形表示拆成粗布局锚点和局部曲线细节，对结构化 token 生成有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VecFontLLM，一个 anchor-guided multimodal large language model。方法先预测并细化 anchor scaffold，用锚点固定组件和轮廓的粗布局，再补全 Bézier 控制点以恢复局部曲率和字体风格；相当于把扁平矢量序列生成改成分层条件生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 细节或定量提升。实验目标是 few-shot 中文矢量字体合成，并与直接矢量序列生成和栅格生成后矢量化的路线形成对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses direct Chinese vector-font synthesis, where component layout, anchor structure, and Bézier-curve details are mixed into long vector sequences and become hard to model for complex characters.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal and structured generation method. It does not directly advance LLM pretraining, but its decomposition of vector graphics into coarse anchors and local curve details is relevant to structured token generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: VecFontLLM is an anchor-guided multimodal large language model. It first predicts and refines an anchor scaffold to fix the coarse layout of components and contours, then completes Bézier control points to recover local curvature and style. This turns flat vector-sequence generation into a hierarchical conditional generation process.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide parameter counts, training data scale, baseline details, or quantitative gains. The evaluation targets few-shot Chinese vector-font synthesis and contrasts direct vector generation with raster-generation-plus-vectorization pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 只看 anchor scaffold 分解思路；它对结构化 token 生成有旁证价值，但不是预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Skim only the anchor-scaffold factorization; it is useful side evidence for structured token generation, not a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Audio-Visual Flamingo: Open Audio-Visual Intelligence for Long and Complex Videos
paper.abstract: We present Audio-Visual Flamingo (AV-Flamingo), a fully open state-of-the-art audio-visual large language model (AV-LLM) for joint understanding and reasoning over audio, images, and long-form videos. Unlike prior AV-LLMs that primarily focus on short clips, AV-Flamingo is designed for understanding and reasoning over long and complex real-world (audio-visual) videos. To support this, we make three key contributions: (i) Audio-Visual-Skills, a large-scale collection of real-world videos with ~7M

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般的视频问答，而是一个更具体也更难的问题：如何把音频与视觉作为同等重要的连续信号，放进一个开放可复现的长视频大模型里，并让模型在长时程、多事件、跨模态依赖的场景下稳定工作。全文反复强调，现有 AV-LLM 的主要短板有三类。第一，训练数据不对：很多模型主要依赖图像-文本、视频-文本或音频单模态数据，真正为音画联合推理构造的数据很少，结果是模型往往把跨模态推理寄希望于“自然涌现”。第二，训练路径不对：短视频感知、长视频时间建模、带时间锚点的推理被混在一起学，导致模型在长视频上容易退化成局部描述器。第三，接口不对：即便编码器分别能看图和听音，缺少显式的时间对齐与交错表示，语言模型很难在统一上下文里追踪“什么时候发生了什么、声音和画面如何对应”。因此，论文的核心问题可以概括为：怎样构造数据、表示和训练课程，使一个开源模型真正学到长视频中的联合音画理解，而不是把音频当附属信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在三点。第一，它把“多模态预训练”的重心从静态图文对齐，推进到长时程音画联合建模。这里最有价值的不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是作者给出了一套较完整的 recipe：数据构造、时间对齐、课程训练、推理格式都围绕长视频 AV reasoning 设计。第二，它说明了一个在基座训练里经常被低估的问题：如果训练语料主要是单模态或弱配对数据，模型会形成明显的视觉偏置，音频信号即便接入了编码器，也未必能在深层推理中被真正使用。第三，它对开放研究社区有实际价值。很多强 AV 模型只有 API 或 open-weight，没有训练数据与方法细节；这篇工作把数据集、训练流程和代码一起公开，使得后续研究可以更认真地研究数据配比、阶段式训练、时间锚定 CoT 这些问题。若从基座视角看，它更像一篇“长序列跨模态预训练 recipe”论文，而不是单纯的应用型视频模型。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三条主线。第一条是模型结构。AV-Flamingo 采用较典型的 encoder-LLM 组合，但关键在于时间轴上的联合表示。视觉侧使用 SigLip 编码图像或视频帧，再通过 Dynamic S2 一类的多尺度压缩模块把高分辨率视觉特征压成较紧凑的 token 序列；音频侧使用 AF-Whisper，并用 sliding-window 机制处理长音频，避免整段音频一次编码带来的长度和计算问题。随后引入 cross-modal interleaving and temporal alignment 模块，把视觉 token 与音频 token 按时间对齐并交错送入文本 LLM。这个设计与“分别做音频问答和视频问答，再把结果交给 LLM 汇总”的路线不同，它试图在输入层就保留时间同步关系，让 LLM 直接在统一序列上做推理。

第二条是数据。作者构建了 Audio-Visual-Skills（AV-Skills），总计约 700 万 caption 和 QA 训练实例，其中约 480 万是 QA。数据覆盖短视频和长视频，并且不是只做表层描述，而是刻意强调 temporal、compositional、cross-modal reasoning。这里的关键判断是：如果训练样本主要是“看见什么”或“听见什么”，模型学到的是感知标签映射；只有当标注要求模型同时利用时间顺序、事件组合和音画互证时，联合推理能力才有机会形成。换句话说，这个数据集的价值不只是规模，而是任务分布与能力目标更一致。

第三条是训练与推理格式。作者提出三阶段 curriculum：pre-training、mid-training、post-training。虽然给出的全文片段没有展开所有 mixture 细节，但从引言和方法描述可以看出，这三阶段对应能力逐步扩展：先建立短程感知与基础对齐，再扩展到长时程、多事件理解，最后通过 targeted post-training 强化复杂推理与指令跟随。与一次性混合所有数据直接训练相比，这种课程式设计更符合长视频能力的形成路径，因为长时程推理建立在稳定的局部感知和跨模态对齐之上。另一个值得注意的点是 TAVIT，即 Temporal Audio-Visual Interleaved Chain-of-Thought。它不是普通 CoT，而是把中间推理步骤显式绑定到时间戳，要求模型在 reasoning trace 中指出相关片段。这相当于给长视频推理增加了“时间 grounding”约束，减少模型只靠语言先验编故事的空间。
summary.experiments:
实验层面，作者声称在 15 个以上音频、视觉、音视频和 omni-modal benchmark 上优于同量级或更大模型，并且在长而复杂的真实视频上更稳。就全文已给出的硬信息，最关键的数字有两组。第一组是数据规模：AV-Skills 约 700 万训练实例，其中约 480 万 QA，对开放 AV 训练来说已经是相当大的量级。第二组是任务覆盖：不仅评测 AV benchmark，也覆盖纯音频、纯视觉和更一般的 omni-modal 任务，这说明模型没有因为强调长视频 AV reasoning 而完全牺牲单模态能力。

从论文叙述看，实验重点不只是最终准确率，而是证明三件事：一，显式构造的 AV 数据比依赖单模态混合训练更能提升联合推理；二，三阶段 curriculum 比平铺式训练更适合长视频；三，带时间锚点的 TAVIT 能改善长视频复杂问答中的可追踪性和鲁棒性。虽然当前提供的全文片段没有列出完整表格数字，但可以合理推断，消融应围绕数据来源、训练阶段、是否使用时间交错/对齐、是否使用 TAVIT 展开。阅读时应重点确认：长视频收益是否主要来自更多数据，还是来自课程设计与时间 grounding；以及模型在纯视觉或纯音频任务上是否出现明显 trade-off。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三件事。第一，看 Introduction 里作者如何界定现有 AV-LLM 的失败模式，尤其是 visual bias、缺少 paired AV data、长视频数据稀缺这几个判断。这部分决定了整篇工作的研究动机是否站得住。第二，看 Methodology 中输入表示的细节，重点是 SigLip + Dynamic S2、AF-Whisper 的 sliding-window，以及 cross-modal interleaving and temporal alignment 模块。这里要弄清楚模型到底是在 token 级联合建模，还是只是把两路 encoder 输出拼接后交给 LLM。第三，看训练章节和实验消融，尤其是三阶段 curriculum 的数据配比变化、长视频样本如何进入训练、TAVIT 在什么任务上带来增益。

如果时间有限，建议优先看图 2 对整体架构的说明、数据集构造部分、以及长视频 benchmark 的主表和消融表，预计 25 到 40 分钟可以形成较完整判断。若要深挖，值得追问两个点：一是时间对齐模块是否真正解决了音画同步建模，还是更多依赖后续 LLM 自己学习；二是 AV-Skills 的标注分布是否足够避免模型只学会模板化时间问答。
summary.authors_note: Nemotron-Labs / NVIDIA 体系的开放多模态工作，标题中明确为 Nemotron-Labs-Audio-Visual Flamingo。全文片段未给出完整作者列表，无法可靠确认具体作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in current audio-visual LLMs: they can often process images and audio separately, but they do not reliably build a shared, temporally grounded representation for long and complex videos. The authors argue that the bottleneck is not just model size. It is a combination of missing paired AV data, weak temporal alignment, and a training path that mixes short-range perception and long-horizon reasoning without a clear curriculum. As a result, many existing systems remain visually biased, use audio only superficially, and struggle when reasoning depends on event order, cross-modal evidence, or long-range dependencies. The core problem is therefore how to train an open AV-LLM that genuinely uses synchronized audio and visual streams for long-form understanding, instead of treating audio as an auxiliary channel.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is more methodological than leaderboard-driven. First, it pushes multimodal pretraining from image-text alignment toward long-horizon audio-visual sequence modeling. That matters because long-form video is closer to the natural setting in which multimodal foundation models will eventually operate. Second, it makes a concrete point about data mixture and representation learning: if training is dominated by unimodal or weakly paired data, the model can expose an audio interface without learning strong audio-conditioned reasoning. Third, the work is fully open in a space where many strong AV systems are closed or only release weights. That makes it useful as a reference recipe for studying data curation, curriculum design, temporal grounding, and cross-modal tokenization choices. From a foundation-model perspective, this is better read as a long-sequence multimodal pretraining recipe than as a narrow video QA paper.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. The first is the architecture. AV-Flamingo uses a vision encoder, an audio encoder, a temporal fusion module, and a text LLM backbone. On the visual side, it adopts SigLip and then applies a Dynamic S2-style spatial multi-scale compression module to reduce dense frame features into a compact token sequence. On the audio side, it uses AF-Whisper with a sliding-window extraction scheme so that long audio can be processed without collapsing everything into a single global representation. The important design choice is the cross-modal interleaving and temporal alignment module: audio and visual tokens are aligned along time and interleaved before entering the LLM. This differs from pipelines that solve audio and video separately and only merge at the answer stage.

The second component is data. The authors build Audio-Visual-Skills, a dataset with about 7 million caption and QA training instances, including about 4.8 million QA pairs. The dataset spans both short and long videos and is explicitly curated for temporal, compositional, and cross-modal reasoning. That is a meaningful distinction. Many multimodal datasets are large but mostly descriptive. Here the supervision is intended to force the model to use event order, audio-visual correspondence, and multi-step evidence aggregation.

The third component is training and reasoning format. The model is trained with a three-stage curriculum: pre-training, mid-training, and post-training. The paper frames this as a progression from short-range perception and alignment toward long-horizon multi-event reasoning, followed by targeted post-training for instruction following and reasoning. This is a more structured alternative to mixing all data at once. The paper also introduces TAVIT, a Temporal Audio-Visual Interleaved Chain-of-Thought format, where intermediate reasoning steps are explicitly grounded to timestamps. That is an important choice for long-video reasoning because it constrains the model to tie its reasoning trace to specific temporal evidence rather than relying only on language priors.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports gains over similarly sized and sometimes larger AV or omni-modal models on more than 15 benchmarks spanning audio-visual, audio-only, vision-only, and broader multimodal settings. The most concrete numbers available from the provided full text are the training data scale and composition: roughly 7 million caption and QA instances in AV-Skills, with about 4.8 million QA pairs. The benchmark coverage is also notable because it suggests the model is not tuned only for one long-video task.

The experimental story appears to center on three claims: explicitly curated AV data improves joint reasoning more than relying on unimodal mixtures; the three-stage curriculum helps long-form understanding more than flatter training; and temporally grounded reasoning with TAVIT improves robustness and traceability on long, complex videos. The provided excerpt does not include the full result tables, so the exact deltas are not visible here. When reading the paper, the key question is whether the long-video gains come mainly from more data, or from the combination of curriculum and temporal grounding. Another useful check is whether stronger AV reasoning introduces any noticeable regression on pure audio or pure vision tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction carefully for the failure diagnosis: visual bias, lack of paired AV data, and the mismatch between short-video training and long-video deployment. That framing is central to the paper. Second, inspect the architecture section around the temporal alignment and interleaving design. The practical question is whether the model performs true token-level joint modeling or mostly concatenates encoder outputs. Third, read the training curriculum and the ablations, especially those involving AV-Skills, stage-wise data mixtures, and TAVIT.

If time is limited, the architecture figure, the dataset construction section, and the main long-video benchmark tables should be enough to form a solid view in about 30 minutes. For deeper reading, two issues are worth probing: whether the temporal alignment module really solves synchronized AV representation learning, and whether the AV-Skills supervision is rich enough to avoid template-driven timestamp reasoning.
summary_en.authors_note: Nemotron-Labs / NVIDIA-affiliated open multimodal work. The provided text identifies the project as Nemotron-Labs-Audio-Visual Flamingo, but the full author list is not visible in the excerpt, so individual author backgrounds cannot be confirmed reliably.

recommendation.zh: 多模态长时序训练的课程设计和数据配比有可落地参考，重点看§3的数据集构造和三阶段训练recipe
recommendation.en: Curriculum design and data mixture for long-context multimodal training are actionable; focus on §3 for dataset construction and 3-stage training recipe

paper.title: Efficient Frame Selection for Long Videos at Test Time with Attention-Based MLLM Selectors
paper.abstract: Understanding long videos with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) requires selecting a compact set of frames from thousands of candidates, yet identifying the right frames seemingly requires understanding the video first. We resolve this circular dependency with a simple observation: cross-modal attention at validation-selected extraction layers in MLLMs already provides query-relevant frame evidence without requiring autoregressive generation. We exploit this property to build DAFS (Dynam

summary.core_problem: 长视频理解中，MLLM 在测试时需要从海量帧里挑少量关键帧，但“要先理解才会选帧”的循环依赖导致成本高、策略难做。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理侧的训练-free 选择器：把现成 MLLM 的跨模态注意力当作“相关性证据”来做帧筛选，减少长视频推理的 token/帧开销；对做多模态长上下文/检索式预处理有工程启发，但不直接推进预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DAFS：在 MLLM 的若干“验证挑选的抽取层”读取 cross-modal attention，把 query-conditioned 的注意力聚合成帧级 relevance score，实现跨帧比较且不需要自回归生成；并把“候选帧池大小”和“每帧 token 预算”做离散优化，以适配 selector 自身上下文限制。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整基准与数值细节；宣称轻量 selector（2B）即可工作，并且无需训练即可在长视频场景做预算感知的帧选择；需要看正文确认：对比哪些长视频 QA/理解基准、相对 uniform sampling 或 learned selector 的提升与成本曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: For long-video MLLM inference, selecting a small set of relevant frames from thousands is costly and seemingly circular: you need understanding to select frames, but selection is needed for understanding.
summary_en.importance: A training-free, inference-time frame selector that reuses cross-modal attention as relevance evidence to cut token/frame budget. Useful as an engineering trick for long-context multimodal pipelines, but it does not materially advance pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: DAFS reads cross-modal attention from a few validation-chosen extraction layers, aggregates it in a query-conditioned way into frame-level relevance scores, enabling cross-frame ranking without autoregressive decoding; additionally solves a discrete budget allocation over candidate pool size and per-frame token budget under the selector’s context limit.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits concrete benchmark numbers; claims a lightweight 2B selector works training-free and is budget-aware. Needs verification in the paper: which long-video benchmarks, baselines (uniform sampling / learned selectors), and cost–quality tradeoff curves.

recommendation.zh: 把 cross-modal attention 当“免费检索信号”挺实用，但更像推理管线技巧；只需看方法和成本-效果曲线，别当成预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Treating cross-modal attention as a “free retrieval signal” is a handy inference trick, but it’s pipeline engineering; skim the method and cost–quality curves, not as a pretraining takeaway.

paper.title: IoUPD: IoU-Aware Privileged Distillation for Visual Grounding with Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Visual grounding with multimodal large language models is commonly formulated as autoregressive coordinate generation, where a model outputs bounding-box coordinates as text given an image and a referring-expression prompt. While this interface is simple and compatible with instruction following, it introduces a mismatch between training and evaluation: training optimizes token-level likelihood over coordinate strings, whereas grounding quality is measured by geometric overlap. We propose IoUPD,

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型做视觉定位时，自回归生成坐标的训练目标（token级似然）与评测指标（IoU几何重叠度）存在不匹配问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出特权蒸馏范式对齐训练与评测目标，属于视觉定位任务的训练方法改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出IoUPD方法，将真实框同时作为坐标目标和训练时的特权指导：学生模型输入原始图像和提示，冻结教师模型输入带框标记的图像和增强提示，通过监督微调锚点+带token权重的特权蒸馏损失训练学生。
summary.experiments: 基于坐标生成式MLLM开展视觉定位任务实验，核心优化IoU指标，未明确提及模型参数量与数据集规模。
summary.authors_note: 中国科学院大学、鹏城实验室团队，无知名研究者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive coordinate generation for visual grounding with multimodal LLMs suffers from a training-evaluation mismatch: training optimizes token-level likelihood of coordinate strings, while evaluation measures geometric IoU overlap.
summary_en.importance: A method-level improvement proposing privileged distillation to align training objectives with evaluation metrics for visual grounding tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: IoUPD uses ground-truth boxes as both coordinate targets and privileged training-time guidance. A frozen teacher takes box-marked images and augmented prompts, while the student takes original inputs. Training combines an SFT anchor with a token-weighted privileged distillation loss.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on coordinate-generating MLLMs for visual grounding, with IoU as the core metric; specific model parameters and dataset sizes not stated in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliated with University of Chinese Academy of Sciences and Peng Cheng Laboratory; no prominent researchers identified.

recommendation.zh: 训练-评测目标不匹配的蒸馏解法仅限视觉定位任务，对LLM预训练目标设计仅有极弱参考，无需细读。
recommendation.en: The distillation solution for training-evaluation mismatch is limited to visual grounding, with negligible reference value for LLM pretraining objective design; no close reading needed.

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
State Key Laboratory of Communication Content Cognition

paper.title: PFAdapter: Hierarchical LoRA Decomposition for Personalized Federated MLLMs
paper.abstract: Agentic AI systems are reshaping communications and networking by deploying autonomous intelligent agents capable of collaborative learning while maintaining data privacy at network edges. Within distributed network environments, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) serve as cognitive engines for edge devices, yet federated fine-tuning faces substantial challenges in balancing global knowledge aggregation with local adaptation under heterogeneous network conditions. Conventional federated pr

summary.core_problem: 联邦多模态大模型微调中，均匀参数聚合混淆领域不变特征和客户端特有特征，导致个性化效果差、通信开销高。
summary.importance: 方法改进类工作，提出分层LoRA分解框架，平衡联邦学习中的全局知识聚合与本地个性化。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PFAdapter，将LoRA适配器参数分层分解为全局共享（Q/K投影）和本地私有（V/输出投影）两部分，全局参数参与联邦聚合，本地参数保留在客户端，减少通信量同时提升个性化性能。
summary.experiments: 在分布式多模态场景下验证，相比传统联邦LoRA方法，通信开销降低，个性化微调效果提升。

summary_en.core_problem: In federated multimodal LLM fine-tuning, uniform parameter aggregation conflates domain-invariant features and client-specific nuances, leading to suboptimal personalization and high communication overhead.
summary_en.importance: Method improvement work proposing a hierarchical LoRA decomposition framework to balance global aggregation and local personalization in federated learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: PFAdapter decomposes LoRA parameters into global-shared (Q/K projections) and local-private (V/output projections) components; global parameters participate in federated aggregation while local parameters stay on clients.
summary_en.experiments: Validated in distributed multimodal scenarios, achieving lower communication overhead and better personalization than traditional federated LoRA methods.

recommendation.zh: 联邦多模态微调的增量改进，核心是LoRA参数分层拆分思路，做参数高效微调的可扫一眼方法部分。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on federated MLLM fine-tuning via hierarchical LoRA decomposition. Glance at the method section if you work on PEFT.

paper.title: Beyond the Eye: Efficient Multimodal Reasoning via Self-Regulated Implicit Visual Tools
paper.abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made remarkable progress on fine-grained perception tasks under the "Thinking with Images" (TwI) paradigm by iteratively performing various visual tool operations. However, this paradigm relies heavily on frequent external tool calls and repeated image re-encoding, which leads to substantial computational overhead and inference latency. To address these issues, we propose Beyond the Eye (BEE), a novel implicit visual tool paradigm centered on

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多模态大模型Thinking with Images范式依赖频繁外部视觉工具调用、重复图像编码导致推理开销和延迟过高的问题。
summary.importance: 多模态推理范式的效率改进，将显式工具调用内化到模型内部，属于MLLM后训练方法的增量创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BEE隐式视觉工具范式，通过两阶段训练：1) 构造形式化思维链SFT数据，将视觉工具调用行为融入训练目标；2) 自调节训练，鼓励模型自适应平衡内部知识与隐式工具调用，避免冗余工具使用。
summary.experiments: 未给出具体模型参数量和数据集规模，仅说明在细粒度感知任务上显著降低推理延迟，同时保持性能。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the high computational overhead and latency in MLLM 'Thinking with Images' paradigms caused by frequent external visual tool calls and repeated image re-encoding.
summary_en.importance: Efficiency-oriented improvement of multimodal reasoning paradigm that internalizes explicit tool calls; incremental innovation in MLLM post-training methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes BEE, an implicit visual tool paradigm with two-stage training: (1) formalized CoT SFT that encodes visual tool invocation behaviors into the training objective; (2) self-regulated training that adaptively balances internal knowledge and implicit tools to avoid redundant usage.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model size and dataset scale not provided; only claims significantly reduced inference latency while maintaining performance on fine-grained perception tasks.

recommendation.zh: MLLM工具调用内化的思路可参考，但实验细节不足，作为后训练范式的弱信号备查即可。
recommendation.en: The idea of internalizing tool calls in MLLMs is worth noting, but experimental details are insufficient; keep as a weak signal for post-training paradigm reference.

paper.title: Mixture of Probes: Learning from Privileged Modalities in Multimodal LLMs Through Probing
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are typically designed under the assumption that all modalities available during training will also be accessible at inference. However, many real-world settings violate this assumption, requiring models to operate under a privileged modality setting, where auxiliary modalities are available only during training. While these modalities contain valuable information, existing MLLMs largely fail to leverage them effectively, as they treat modalities as inter

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型在训练时可见辅助模态、推理时缺失这些模态的 privileged modality 场景下，如何把辅助模态转化为可迁移监督的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态表示学习方法。它关注的不是增加输入模态，而是区分模态特有信号和跨模态通用信号，对训练视觉、音频等辅助 encoder 时如何避免推理依赖有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Mixture of Probes，通过结构化 probing 机制从共享模态 encoder 的中间表征中提取信息，并组织为模态特定与模态通用两类信号。方法目标是保留模态依赖结构，同时学习能在缺失模态推理时使用的 transferable representations。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据规模、任务集合、baseline 名称和提升幅度。能确认的是实验围绕 MLLM 的 privileged modality setting，比较现有把模态视作可互换输入的做法与 MoP 的表示解耦策略。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Sony Group Corporation 和 University of North Carolina at Charlotte。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses privileged-modality learning for MLLMs, where auxiliary modalities are available during training but absent at inference.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal representation-learning method. Its value is in treating auxiliary modalities as complementary supervision rather than as inputs that must remain available at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mixture of Probes uses structured probes over intermediate representations of a shared modality encoder to separate modality-specific signals from modality-general signals, aiming to preserve modality-dependent structure while learning transferable representations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model scale, dataset size, baseline details, or quantitative gains. The described evaluation targets MLLMs under privileged-modality assumptions and compares against designs that treat modalities as interchangeable inputs.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Sony Group Corporation and the University of North Carolina at Charlotte.

recommendation.zh: 看摘要和方法图即可；问题设定比方法更有用，可作为多模态预训练中“训练可见、推理缺失”模态蒸馏的备选思路。
recommendation.en: Skim the setup and method diagram; the privileged-modality framing is more useful than the specific probing machinery for pretraining work.

institutions: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

paper.title: Scene Graph Thinking: Reinforcing Structured Visual Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong perception and reasoning capabilities. However, most existing models focus on isolated objects and neglect structured relationships for efficient target navigation, limiting their performance on visually intensive tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Scene Graph Thinking (SaGe), a novel paradigm that enables fine-grained and structured visual reasoning through explicit scene-graph representations. Specifically, we first

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 MLLM 在复杂视觉场景中缺少结构化关系建模的问题。现有“think-with-image”方法多依赖裁剪、放大和局部搜索，能改善局部感知，但容易把对象当成孤立实体处理，无法稳定利用对象、部件、属性、空间位置和交互关系之间的结构信息。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在基座训练 recipe，而在 VLM 后训练数据构造和奖励设计。它提供了一个可复用的思路：把平坦图文语料转换成显式场景图，再用图采样生成推理轨迹，使模型学习一种更可控的视觉推理中间表示。对 native multimodal pretraining 或 mid-training 也有启发：视觉数据不一定只以 caption、QA 或 dense caption 形式进入训练，可以先组织成层次化、关系化的表示，再映射成监督或强化学习信号。
summary.technical_approach: SaGe 的方法分两步。第一步是自动数据引擎，把图像和文本标注转换成层次化 scene graph。图中的节点表示对象、子实体或部件，并附带属性描述、bounding box、深度范围等信息；边表示空间关系、交互关系和语义关系。作者还设计了 sub-entity mining，把对象拆成更细粒度的层级节点，避免 scene graph 只停留在粗对象级别。第二步是基于图的训练数据生成与后训练。系统从图中采样节点和边，构造 node-centric 与 edge-centric QA；前者训练颜色、材质、状态、位置等细粒度属性，后者训练空间布局、交互、归属等关系判断。每条样本配有 node-articulated CoT，即在推理链中显式写出实体名、框坐标和深度线索。作者还沿图边做 traversal，合成多跳导航轨迹和综合场景描述。冷启动阶段使用 120K 结构化样本做监督训练；随后用 GRPO 做强化后训练，奖励包括 node-relevance reward 和 node-grounded reward，前者鼓励推理路径选中与问题语义相关的节点，后者鼓励引用实体的空间定位准确。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 SaGe 在 8 个视觉密集型 benchmark 上取得稳定提升，覆盖细粒度感知、关系推理和目标导航类能力。关键实验重点不是单一指标，而是结构化数据与图奖励是否能让模型更少依赖盲目裁剪搜索。给出的核心规模是 120K 高质量结构化训练样本。根据方法设计，最应关注的消融包括：去掉 scene graph 结构、去掉 sub-entity 层级、只用节点 QA 或只用边 QA、去掉 node-articulated CoT、只做 SFT 不做 GRPO、分别移除 node-relevance 与 node-grounded reward。摘要和引言中未给出具体分数表，精确提升幅度需要看实验表格。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Introduction，理解它与裁剪/放大式视觉推理方法的区别。然后看数据引擎部分，重点关注节点如何层次化、边如何分类、bbox 与 depth cue 如何进入文本监督。方法部分最有信息量的是 graph sampling、graph traversal 和 node-articulated CoT 的构造方式。强化学习部分建议看 reward 定义，而不是只看 GRPO 名称；真正的设计点在于把 scene graph 节点作为 reward proxy。实验部分优先看消融表和错误案例，判断增益来自结构化表示、数据量，还是来自额外推理链格式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete weakness of current MLLMs: they can zoom into local regions, but they often lack an explicit representation of objects, parts, attributes, spatial layout, and relations. This makes fine-grained visual reasoning inefficient and brittle in cluttered scenes.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is in multimodal post-training data design rather than base pretraining. The useful idea is to turn flat image-text corpora into structured scene graphs, then sample supervision and RL signals from that structure. This points to a broader direction for VLM training: visual supervision can be organized as hierarchical and relational evidence, not only as captions, QA pairs, or cropped-region prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach: SaGe builds an automated pipeline that converts image-text examples into hierarchical scene graphs. Nodes represent objects, sub-entities, or parts, enriched with attributes, bounding boxes, and estimated depth ranges. Edges encode spatial, interaction, and semantic relations. A sub-entity mining step increases granularity, so the graph is not limited to coarse object nodes. The training data is then produced by LLM-guided graph sampling and traversal. Node-centric samples ask about attributes such as color, material, state, and location; edge-centric samples ask about relations such as spatial layout, interaction, and ownership. The reasoning traces are node-articulated: entity names, coordinates, and depth cues are explicitly written as evidence. The first stage uses 120K structured examples for cold-start supervised training. The second stage applies GRPO with two node-based rewards: a node-relevance reward for selecting semantically appropriate graph nodes, and a node-grounded reward for accurate localization of referenced entities.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports consistent gains on eight visually intensive benchmarks, especially for fine-grained perception, relational reasoning, and navigation-like visual reasoning. The central data scale is 120K structured training examples. The most informative experimental checks are the ablations: removing the scene graph, removing hierarchical sub-entities, comparing node-only and edge-only supervision, dropping node-articulated CoT, using SFT without GRPO, and separately disabling the node-relevance or node-grounded reward. Exact score deltas are not visible in the provided text and should be read from the result tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25 minutes. Start with Figure 1 and the introduction to understand why crop-and-zoom reasoning is insufficient. Then read the data engine section carefully: node hierarchy, edge taxonomy, bounding boxes, and depth cues are the important details. In the training section, focus on graph sampling, graph traversal, and the construction of node-articulated reasoning traces. For the RL part, read the reward definitions rather than the GRPO wrapper. In the experiments, prioritize ablations and qualitative failures; they reveal whether the gains come from structure, data volume, or simply the imposed reasoning format.

recommendation.zh: “视觉版显式CoT”思路值得一看，重点看数据引擎怎么从图文造scene-graph轨迹；RL剪枝部分像常规后训练技巧，跳过不影响判断
recommendation.en: Interesting take on explicit visual CoT via scene graphs; focus on the data-engine section that synthesizes graph traces from image-text pairs; the RL pruning stage is standard post-training, skimmable.

paper.title: Token-level Response-visual Attention Guidance for Multimodal LLMs Knowledge Distillation
paper.abstract: While knowledge distillation (KD) is widely adopted for training lightweight models by leveraging supervision from larger teacher models, relying solely on output token distributions has proven insufficient for compressing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Since output tokens are a byproduct of the model attending to visual inputs, prior works have explored explicitly distilling attention to provide a direct supervisory signal. While promising, the precise utility of which attention sign

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是多模态大模型蒸馏里一个很具体但常被处理得过于粗糙的问题：到底应该蒸馏哪一类跨模态注意力。已有方法通常把 prompt-to-vision attention 当成主要监督信号，但作者通过系统分析发现，真正和下游性能强相关的不是“模型在读指令时怎么看图”，而是“模型在生成每个 response token 时怎么看图”。换句话说，关键监督信号发生在解码阶段，而不是输入理解阶段。进一步地，不同 response token 对视觉证据的依赖差异很大，统一地对所有 token 施加同一种 attention distillation loss 会把监督做平。
summary.importance: 这篇对纯预训练的直接影响有限，因为它主要是 MLLM 蒸馏而不是基座预训练 recipe。但它对统一多模态建模和蒸馏目标设计有一个清楚的启发：如果输出 token 是视觉 grounding 的结果，那么蒸馏不该只盯着最终 logits，也不该把所有 cross-modal attention 一视同仁，而要对生成阶段、token 级别的视觉依赖做更细粒度建模。这个结论对后续做 MLLM 压缩、teacher-student 对齐、甚至设计 native multimodal pretraining loss 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
作者先把跨模态注意力明确拆成两类：
- Prompt-to-Vision attention：prompt token 作为 query，看向视觉 token；
- Response-to-Vision attention：response token 作为 query，看向视觉 token。

论文的第一步不是直接提方法，而是做相关性分析，比较 student 与 teacher 在这两类 attention 上的相似度和最终任务性能的关系。结论是后者显著更关键，因此方法设计完全转向 response-to-vision。

在此基础上，作者提出 TRAG，核心是 token-level response-visual attention guidance。它不是对所有 response token 的 attention map 做统一 KL，而是根据 teacher attention 的熵自适应调整蒸馏强度。直觉上，如果 teacher 在某个 token 上的视觉注意力分布很尖锐，说明这是一个强 grounding token，比如具体物体、位置、属性词，此时 student 应更精确地对齐；如果 teacher 分布较平，说明该 token 更依赖全局场景或语言先验，比如功能词、连接词，此时不应强迫 student 去拟合一个并不稀疏的局部模式。

因此 TRAG 的关键不是“蒸馏 attention”本身，而是把 teacher attention entropy 当作 token-wise 难度和监督形态的指示器，用它调制 KL loss，在 coverage 与 precision 之间做自适应平衡。相比已有方法，它有两个明确区别：一是监督位置从 prompt phase 转到 generation phase；二是监督粒度从 sequence-level / uniform loss 转到 token-level adaptive loss。
summary.experiments:
从引言和方法部分能确认的核心实验结论有三类。

第一类是相关性分析。作者显示，student-teacher 的 response-to-vision attention 相似度与下游性能强相关，而 prompt-to-vision attention 相似度几乎没有可用相关性。这一点是整篇工作的立论基础。

第二类是 attention pattern 分析。作者观察到 response token 的跨模态注意力方差很大：有些 token 需要尖锐、局部的视觉聚焦，有些 token 只需要弥散的场景级上下文。这直接说明统一蒸馏目标不合适，也解释了为什么过去方法收益有限。

第三类是 benchmark 对比。TRAG 在多个多模态基准上优于竞争蒸馏基线，同时在 attention fidelity 上也更好。给定当前提供的全文片段，没有看到完整的参数规模、teacher/student 组合、具体 benchmark 名称和逐项数值表，因此不能可靠复述精确数字；但从论文叙述看，作者不仅比较了最终任务分数，也比较了 attention alignment 本身，并把两者联系起来，而不是只报任务结果。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点不是实现细节，而是问题拆分方式。

先看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，弄清作者为什么把 cross-modal attention 分成 P→V 和 R→V 两段，以及这种划分在自回归 MLLM 中为什么自然。然后重点看相关性分析和 attention entropy 统计的图表，这两部分决定了 TRAG 是否站得住：如果没有这两个观察，后面的 adaptive KL 只是一个经验技巧。

方法部分主要看 teacher attention entropy 如何进入 loss，以及它具体调节了什么。实验部分建议优先看：1）不同 attention supervision 位置的对比；2）uniform vs token-adaptive objective 的消融；3）attention fidelity 与任务性能是否同步提升。

预计阅读时间 20 到 30 分钟。如果你做的是纯文本 LLM 预训练，这篇不用深读；如果你关心 multimodal distillation、统一建模或生成阶段 grounding 信号，这篇有一定参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but important question in multimodal LLM distillation: which cross-modal attention signals are actually worth distilling. Prior work mostly emphasizes prompt-to-vision attention, assuming that better visual grounding during prompt encoding should transfer to the student. The authors show that this is largely the wrong target. What correlates with downstream performance is response-to-vision attention, namely how the model attends to visual tokens while generating each response token. They also show that this signal is highly heterogeneous across tokens, so a uniform distillation objective is poorly matched to the structure of the problem.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to multimodal foundation-model training and compression. The main lesson is that if output tokens are produced through token-wise visual grounding, then distillation should not stop at logits, and it should not treat all cross-modal attention equally. The generative phase carries the more useful supervision. That insight is useful for MLLM compression, teacher-student alignment, and potentially for designing better multimodal training objectives where grounding quality matters during decoding rather than only during input fusion.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper first formalizes two kinds of cross-modal attention in autoregressive MLLMs:
- Prompt-to-Vision (P→V): prompt tokens query visual tokens during instruction encoding.
- Response-to-Vision (R→V): response tokens query visual tokens during decoding.

Instead of proposing a loss immediately, the authors begin with an empirical characterization. They measure how teacher-student similarity in each attention type relates to downstream performance. The main finding is that R→V similarity matters, while P→V similarity contributes little.

Based on this, they propose TRAG, Token-level Response-visual Attention Guidance. The method discards prompt-phase attention supervision and focuses entirely on response-phase visual attention. More importantly, it does not apply a uniform KL loss over all response tokens. The loss is modulated by the entropy of the teacher’s attention distribution for each token.

The intuition is straightforward. Some generated tokens require sharp, localized visual grounding, such as object names or attributes. Others rely on diffuse scene-level context or mostly linguistic priors, such as function words. Teacher attention entropy acts as a token-wise indicator of this distinction. Low-entropy teacher attention suggests precise grounding and should induce stronger, sharper alignment; high-entropy attention suggests broader coverage and should not force the student into an artificially peaky pattern. In that sense, TRAG is less about “distilling attention” in general and more about matching the supervision shape to the grounding role of each generated token.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, three experimental claims are clear.

First, the correlation study shows that student-teacher similarity in response-to-vision attention is strongly associated with downstream task performance, whereas prompt-to-vision similarity has negligible utility. This is the empirical basis for the whole method.

Second, the paper analyzes token-level attention variance and finds substantial heterogeneity across generated tokens. Some tokens exhibit concentrated visual focus, others broad and diffuse attention. This supports the argument that a single uniform distillation objective is mismatched.

Third, TRAG outperforms competitive distillation baselines on multiple multimodal benchmarks and also improves attention fidelity. However, the excerpt provided here does not include the full experimental tables, exact teacher-student model sizes, benchmark list, or reliable numeric deltas, so it would be unsafe to restate precise numbers. What is clear is that the paper evaluates both end-task performance and attention alignment, rather than reporting only task metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and preliminaries to understand why the P→V versus R→V split is natural in autoregressive multimodal decoders. Then focus on the correlation analysis and the entropy-based characterization of response-token attention. Those sections carry the real argument. Without them, the adaptive KL objective would look like a heuristic.

In the method section, pay attention to how teacher attention entropy enters the loss and what exactly it modulates. In the experiments, prioritize three comparisons: prompt-phase versus response-phase supervision, uniform versus token-adaptive distillation, and whether attention-fidelity gains track task-performance gains.

About 20 to 30 minutes is enough. If your work is centered on text-only pretraining, this is peripheral. If you care about multimodal distillation, unified modeling, or grounding during generation, it is a useful read.

recommendation.zh: 推翻了MLLM蒸馏用prompt-to-vision注意力的常规做法，注意力信号选择的结论可直接复用到内部多模态蒸馏ablation，重点看§3相关性分析
recommendation.en: Overturns the common practice of distilling prompt-to-vision attention in MLLM KD; attention signal selection conclusions can be directly reused in internal multimodal distillation ablations, focus on §3 correlation analysis

While explicit visual generation incurs prohibitive computational costs, existing latent approaches often rely on external experts or lack rigorous cognitive logic. In this paper, we introduce ProLaViT (Progressive Latent Visual Thought), a framework empowering MLLMs to perform structured visual derivation in the

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型在复杂多步视觉推理任务上表现不佳，显式视觉生成成本过高，latent方法要么依赖外部专家模型，要么缺乏严谨认知逻辑的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出基于内生自蒸馏的结构化latent视觉推理框架ProLaViT，无需外部专家模型即可让模型内化多步视觉推导的算法精度，为多模态复杂推理提供新路径

paper.title: Hidden Forgetting in Continual Multimodal Learning: When Accuracy Survives but Grounding Fails
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models must continually adapt to evolving tasks and domains, yet standard continual learning metrics mainly measure whether old answers remain correct, leaving the stability of multimodal grounding largely unexamined. We study this overlooked failure mode and ask whether a continually adapted MLLM can preserve not only what it answers, but also how it uses visual, textual, OCR, chart, and document evidence. We identify \emph{hidden evidence-use forgetting}, where answer

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态持续学习方法主要围绕答案准确率评估和缓解遗忘，但存在一种被答案指标掩盖的「隐藏遗忘」——模型在历史任务上的答案准确率保持稳定，但支撑答案的多模态证据使用模式发生漂移（如从依赖视觉接地证据转向依赖语言先验捷径），导致推理可靠性下降，而现有方法未覆盖这一维度的遗忘。
summary.importance: 揭示了多模态持续学习中此前被忽视的证据使用层面的遗忘，拓展了持续学习的评估维度，对需要高接地可靠性的多模态模型持续适配场景（如安全敏感应用）有参考价值，也为持续学习的约束设计提供了新的方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出无回放的依赖约束持续学习框架（RCL）。核心思路是将前一阶段的模型作为行为参考，通过反事实通道干预（逐一抑制视觉区域、OCR、图表元素等证据通道）估计两个模型的模态依赖剖面（即各通道对预测的贡献程度）；在适配新任务时，联合优化三项损失：当前任务损失、答案输出分布保留损失、证据依赖模式保留损失。框架仅更新参数高效的适配模块，推理时无额外开销。
summary.experiments: 在8阶段多模态任务流上的先导实验有三个核心发现：一是答案保留不代表证据使用保留，许多任务转换中答案准确率下降不足2%，但证据敏感度漂移幅度很大；二是顺序LoRA有14.4%的诊断切片处于隐藏漂移区，输出层蒸馏虽将平均准确率下降从2.72%降至1.57%，但隐藏漂移比例升至66.3%，在OCR、图表、文档类任务上尤为突出；三是提出的RCL框架可同时提升答案保留率和证据接地稳定性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第1章隐藏遗忘的问题提出、第2章先导研究的实验发现，以及第3章的依赖约束损失设计，预计阅读时间25-35分钟。关注评估方法的读者可重点查看证据使用向量的构造和隐藏遗忘的度量指标。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing continual multimodal learning methods evaluate and mitigate forgetting primarily via answer accuracy, but overlook a form of "hidden forgetting": a model may retain correct answers on historical tasks while shifting its reliance across multimodal evidence channels (e.g., from grounded visual evidence to linguistic prior shortcuts), which degrades reasoning reliability without being detected by standard evaluation metrics.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a previously underexplored dimension of forgetting in continual multimodal learning, expanding the evaluation scope of continual adaptation. It is relevant for MLLM deployment scenarios requiring high grounding reliability, such as safety-critical applications, and provides a new direction for designing constraints in continual learning pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed replay-free Reliance-Constrained Learning (RCL) framework uses the previous-stage model as a behavioral reference. It estimates modality reliance profiles for both the reference and current models via counterfactual channel interventions—selectively suppressing evidence channels such as visual regions, OCR tokens, or chart elements to measure their contribution to predictions. During adaptation to a new task, the framework jointly optimizes three losses: current task loss, answer output distribution preservation loss, and evidence reliance pattern preservation loss. Only parameter-efficient adaptation modules are updated, with no additional inference cost.
summary_en.experiments: Pilot experiments on an 8-stage multimodal task stream show three key findings: 1) Answer preservation does not guarantee evidence-use preservation, with many task transitions exhibiting large evidence-sensitivity drift despite less than 2% accuracy drop; 2) Sequential LoRA has 14.4% of diagnostic slices in the hidden drift region, while output-level distillation reduces average accuracy drop from 2.72% to 1.57% but increases hidden drift to 66.3%, most pronounced in OCR, chart, and document tasks; 3) The RCL framework improves both answer retention and evidence grounding stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, focus on the introduction of hidden forgetting in Section 1, the pilot study findings in Section 2, and the reliance-constrained loss design in Section 3. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes. Readers interested in evaluation methods may also check the construction of evidence-use vectors and hidden forgetting metrics.

recommendation.zh: 发现了多模态持续学习的关键盲区——准确率不变但证据 grounding 漂移，反事实依赖估计的方法可直接迁移到预训练行为一致性评估，重点看§2的失效模式分析和§3.2的干预方法。
recommendation.en: Identifies a critical blind spot in multimodal continual learning (preserved accuracy but shifted evidence grounding); counterfactual reliance estimation can be directly adapted to pretraining behavior consistency evaluation, focus on §2 failure mode analysis and §3.2 intervention design.

paper.title: InduceKV: Fixed-Footprint Continual Adaptation of Multimodal LLMs via Inducing KV Memories
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models must adapt to evolving tasks and domains, yet continual improvement under bounded deployment footprint remains difficult because repeated parameter updates or growing replay stores can accumulate adaptation state over time. We study fixed-footprint continual adaptation: the deployed adaptation state is kept under a fixed memory budget, while the backbone model is left unchanged and task-specific updates are externalized. We propose InduceKV, a retrieval-based met

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型在持续适配新任务与新领域时，现有方法难以同时满足「固定部署内存占用」的约束——参数更新类方法（如PEFT、专家路由）会不断增加模型状态、可能扰动预训练跨模态接口，回放类方法则受限于内存预算难以平衡历史能力保留与新任务学习。
summary.importance: 将多模态持续适配从「参数增量更新」问题重构为「预算约束下的外部记忆分配」问题，提供了完全冻结骨干网络、通过注意力原生KV记忆注入实现能力增量的技术路径，对需要严格控制部署后模型状态、避免扰动预训练基座的持续适配场景有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 冻结全部MLLM骨干参数，将任务增量知识编码为注意力兼容的外部KV记忆条目。每个条目包含两部分：一是固定表示空间中的单位范数检索键（由前缀最后一层隐状态池化得到），二是逐层KV载荷（通过固定平均池化矩阵将前缀KV压缩至统一长度m，保证所有记忆条目长度一致）。推理时通过余弦相似度检索相关记忆，将其KV载荷作为额外缓存令牌注入每层自注意力参与生成。记忆库构建采用双层优化：内层拟合轻量检索校准参数以适配当前任务，外层在固定记忆预算下选择条目，同时优化当前任务似然、历史锚点集的能力保留，以及检索空间中的冗余感知谱覆盖正则项以降低记忆冗余。
summary.experiments: 在持续指令调优、持续视觉问答等多种多模态持续学习场景下，性能优于现有基线方法。完整消融实验与量化结果需参考原文全文学术版本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第1章中「固定内存占用（fixed footprint）」持续适配的问题定义、第2章的KV记忆构造方式与双层优化框架，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。关注部署效率的读者可查看推理时KV注入的开销分析相关章节。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require continual adaptation to new tasks and domains in production, but existing methods cannot satisfy a fixed deployment memory footprint constraint while preserving historical competencies and generalizability. Parameter-updating approaches (e.g., PEFT, expert routing) grow model state over time and risk disrupting the pretrained cross-modal interface, while replay-based methods struggle to balance retention and new task learning within tight memory budgets.
summary_en.importance: This work reframes continual MLLM adaptation as a budgeted external memory allocation problem rather than a parameter increment problem, providing a path for capacity expansion via attention-native KV memory injection without modifying the pretrained backbone. It is relevant for deployment scenarios requiring strict bounds on model state size and minimal perturbation to the base model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The entire MLLM backbone is frozen, and task-specific knowledge is stored as external, attention-compatible KV memory entries. Each entry has two components: a unit-norm retrieval key (pooled from final-layer prefix hidden states) in a fixed representation space, and layer-wise KV payloads compressed to a uniform length m via a static average pooling matrix to ensure consistent entry size. At inference, relevant memories are retrieved via cosine similarity and injected as additional cache tokens into each layer’s masked self-attention. The memory bank is built via bilevel optimization: an inner loop fits lightweight retrieval calibration parameters for the current task, while an outer loop selects a budgeted subset of entries to jointly optimize current-task likelihood, retention on historical anchor sets, and a redundancy-aware spectral coverage regularizer in the frozen retrieval space.
summary_en.experiments: The method outperforms existing baselines across multiple continual multimodal learning settings, including continual instruction tuning and continual VQA. Full ablation studies and detailed quantitative results are available in the full version of the work.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, focus on the problem definition of fixed-footprint continual adaptation in Section 1, and the KV memory construction + bilevel optimization framework in Section 2. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes. Readers interested in deployment efficiency may also check the section on inference overhead of KV injection.

recommendation.zh: 多模态LLM的固定内存持续适配方案，核心是KV记忆的检索式复用，可参考§3的双层选择策略设计，无需通读全文。
recommendation.en: Fixed-footprint continual adaptation for MLLMs via retrieval-augmented KV memories; focus on §3's bilevel selection design for parameter-efficient adaptation, skip full text.

paper.title: Wake up for Touch! Mask-isolated Tactile Alignment Learning in MLLMs
paper.abstract: Touch supplies the physical grounding needed to perceive intrinsic material properties, such as friction and compliance, that vision alone often cannot resolve. Recent efforts for equipping multimodal LLMs with this tactile sense, however, expose a zero-sum trade-off: the limited parameter budget of compact models forces a choice between acquiring the new sensory modality and preserving the established vision-language reasoning. We present Splash, a mask-isolated tactile alignment learning frame

summary.core_problem: 解决小型多模态 LLM 接入触觉模态时，学习新感知能力与保留原有视觉语言能力之间的灾难性遗忘问题。
summary.importance: 这是多模态扩展与参数隔离训练方法，价值在于讨论“向已有 MLLM 添加新模态时如何非破坏性更新”。它不是基座预训练 recipe，但对统一多模态预训练和 continual modality expansion 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Splash，一个 mask-isolated tactile alignment learning 框架。方法先估计预训练参数的重要性，将参数空间划分为 critical subspace 与 dormant subspace；critical 参数冻结以锚定原有视觉语言能力，dormant 参数用于学习触觉到 LLM 表示的对齐，从而降低触觉学习对已有能力的干扰。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了 extensive experiments，重点验证 Splash 能同时获得触觉对齐能力并减少视觉语言能力遗忘。给定信息未包含模型规模、触觉数据规模、baseline 名称、任务集或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses catastrophic forgetting when compact multimodal LLMs are extended with tactile sensing while trying to preserve their existing vision-language reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a modality-expansion and parameter-isolation method. Its value is in the training question of how to add a new sensory channel to an existing MLLM without destructive updates, which is relevant to continual multimodal pretraining but not a core LLM pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Splash, a mask-isolated tactile alignment framework. The method estimates the significance of pretrained parameters, partitions them into critical and dormant subspaces, freezes the critical subspace as an anchor for existing visual knowledge, and updates only the dormant subspace to learn tactile-to-LLM alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments showing that Splash improves tactile alignment while mitigating forgetting of vision-language abilities. The provided information does not include model sizes, tactile dataset scale, exact baselines, task suites, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看参数重要性分区和遗忘评测设计即可；它像小模型模态扩展技巧，不足以改变统一预训练路线。
recommendation.en: Read only the parameter-partitioning and forgetting-evaluation setup; this is a compact-model modality-expansion trick, not a shift in unified pretraining.

paper.title: Attend, Transform, or Silence: Operator-Level Visual Skipping for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly process long visual-token sequences, increasing the overall inference computation. Existing acceleration methods usually remove visual tokens or skip visual-token updates in entire layers, but these coarse strategies may discard fine-grained evidence or suppress useful operators together with redundant ones. In this paper, we study visual-token computation from an answer-observable perspective and find that late visual-token updates can remai

summary.core_problem: 现有MLLM推理加速方法依赖粗粒度冗余判断：token级剪枝会不可逆丢失细粒度视觉证据，层级跳过将注意力和FFN绑定处理、无法区分单算子冗余；同时仅用隐状态更新幅度判断冗余，会误判大量对答案无实际贡献的“answer-silent”视觉更新为有效计算。
summary.importance: 提出算子级的视觉冗余分析视角，补充了MLLM计算效率研究的分析维度；无需重训练的跳过框架对高分辨率、长视觉序列MLLM的部署有实用价值，其answer-observable诊断方法也可迁移到其他多模态架构的效率分析中。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 设计answer-observable诊断指标，衡量视觉token更新是否传播到答案token的隐状态，识别出深层中大量更新幅度大但不影响最终输出的answer-silent冗余；2. 将Transformer层拆分为注意力和FFN两个独立算子，分别评估二者的答案可观测贡献，发现不同层存在注意力主导、FFN主导或双算子冗余的异质性；3. 实现算子级视觉跳过框架，保留完整视觉token序列，仅跳过每层中被判定为冗余的单个算子（注意力或FFN）的视觉计算，避免不可逆token丢失和固定算子偏好的限制。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3VL等多个MLLM架构、10个VQA基准上测试，最高可减少33.7%的视觉计算量，平均性能变化仅0.5%；消融实验验证了answer-observable指标相比原始更新幅度指标的有效性，以及算子级粒度相比token级、层级策略的优势。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第2节的answer-silent现象分析、算子级异质性实验及对应图表，以及第3节跳过框架的核心逻辑；预计阅读时间15-20分钟，无需深究实现细节，核心吸收冗余判断的新维度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MLLM inference acceleration methods rely on coarse redundancy granularities: token-level pruning irreversibly discards fine-grained visual evidence, while layer-level skipping couples attention and FFN computation and cannot isolate operator-specific redundancy. Judging redundancy solely by hidden-state update magnitude also misclassifies large but answer-irrelevant visual updates as useful computation.
summary_en.importance: It introduces an operator-level perspective for visual redundancy analysis, expanding the analytical toolkit for MLLM computational efficiency. The training-free skipping framework delivers practical value for deploying high-resolution or long-visual-sequence MLLMs, and the answer-observable diagnostic can be generalized to efficiency analysis of other multimodal architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Propose answer-observable diagnostics that measure whether visual token updates propagate to answer token hidden states, identifying widespread "answer-silent" redundancy in late layers where large visual updates do not affect final outputs. 2. Decompose each Transformer layer into separate attention and FFN operators, and evaluate their individual answer-observable contributions, revealing layer-wise heterogeneity: some layers are attention-dominant, some FFN-dominant, and others redundant in both operators. 3. Design an operator-level visual skipping framework that retains the full visual token sequence and only bypasses the redundant operator (attention or FFN) for visual tokens in each layer, avoiding irreversible token loss and fixed operator preference assumptions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across multiple MLLM architectures (including Qwen3VL) and 10 VQA benchmarks. It achieves up to 33.7% visual computation reduction with only 0.5% average performance change. Ablation studies validate the superiority of answer-observable metrics over raw update magnitude, and the advantage of operator-level granularity over token-level or layer-level strategies.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2's analysis of the answer-silent phenomenon and operator-level heterogeneity experiments (and corresponding figures), plus the core logic of the skipping framework in Section 3. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes; no need to dive deep into implementation details, prioritize absorbing the new redundancy judgment dimension.

recommendation.zh: 算子级视觉token跳过的思路比整层剪枝更精细，重点看§3关于answer-silent冗余的分析与Fig 2的算子影响分布，可迁移到长上下文推理优化。
recommendation.en: Operator-level visual token skipping is finer-grained than layer pruning; focus on §3 analysis of answer-silent redundancy and Fig 2 operator impact distribution, transferable to long-context inference optimization.

paper.title: MS-Resampler: Multi-Scope Visual Resampling for Efficient Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically employ resampling-based projectors to transform dense visual features into a compact token sequence for language modeling. Most existing resamplers adopt a single, fixed aggregation scope via global cross-attention, which can blur fine-grained local evidence and limit the ability to capture both local details and global context within a fixed token budget. In this work, we propose MS-Resampler, a multi-scope visual resampling framework for MLLMs

summary.core_problem: 解决 MLLM 中视觉 resampler 用固定全局聚合范围压缩视觉特征时，局部细节和全局上下文难以同时保留的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态 LLM 视觉投影器改进。它对视觉 token 压缩、projector 设计和固定 token budget 下的信息保留有参考意义，但整体更像模块级增量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MS-Resampler，在 resampling attention 中注入显式空间范围先验，构造多个 scope-specific resampler 分支；每个分支负责不同粒度的视觉聚合，从局部到全局，再通过自适应融合生成最终视觉表示供语言模型使用。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 10 个公开多模态 benchmark 上持续提升视觉理解表现，但未给出模型规模、训练数据量、token 数预算、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度；需要看正文确认收益是否来自 resampler 结构而非训练配置差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the loss of local evidence and global context when MLLM visual resamplers compress dense visual features with a single fixed aggregation scope.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a visual projector improvement for multimodal LLMs. It is relevant to visual-token compression and projector design under a fixed token budget, though it appears modular rather than paradigm-level.
summary_en.technical_approach: MS-Resampler injects explicit spatial-scope priors into resampling attention and builds multiple scope-specific branches. Each branch aggregates visual information at a different granularity, from local to global, and their outputs are adaptively fused before being passed to the language model.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports consistent gains on ten public multimodal benchmarks, but does not provide model scale, training data, token budget, baseline names, or numerical improvements. The full paper should be checked for whether gains are isolated to the resampler design.

recommendation.zh: 只看 resampler 设计和 token budget 消融；若没有严控训练配方，benchmark 提升只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the resampler design and token-budget ablations; without tightly controlled training recipes, benchmark gains are weak evidence.

paper.title: Before Thinking, Learn to Decide: Proactive Routing for Efficient Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large multimodal models have achieved strong reasoning on complex visual tasks, but their inference efficiency is often restricted by long chains of thought. A promising solution is to pair a small draft model with a large target model, enabling cooperative inference employing a routing signal that adaptively routes queries to either the draft or target model based on their difficulties for optimal efficiency and accuracy. Yet, the remaining bottleneck is to establish a reliable query difficulty

summary.core_problem: 在多模态视觉推理中，如何在不依赖“生成完长 CoT 后再看 token 概率”的滞后信号、也不依赖对采样分布敏感的 SFT 特殊 token 方案的前提下，提前判断样本难度并进行 draft/target 模型路由，从而降低推理成本。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理效率与路由策略，不是预训练主线。对预训练研究的间接启发在于：它把“难度/可解性”建模成可学习的评分头，并用 RL（GRPO）训练在生成前给出可用信号；这种“前置评分信号”如果迁移到 pretrain/posttrain 接口上，可能用于数据课程、动态采样或训练时的 compute routing（例如 MoE/early-exit 的数据侧信号）。但论文的核心贡献仍在推理阶段系统设计。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Proactive Routing Paradigm (PRP)：在生成开始前就做路由。
- DRL (Draft Rating Learning)：让 draft 模型在不生成推理链的情况下，直接对输入给出“我能否解”的细粒度评分分布。
- JRL (Joint Rating Learning)：进一步同时预测 target 模型对该样本的适配度/收益，使路由不仅把难题交给大模型，也能把“大模型特别擅长”的样本交给它。
- 训练方法：使用 GRPO 风格的强化学习来学评分（全文应给出 reward 设计与采样细节）。
- 推理策略：基于评分的三阶段路由与排序策略；DRL 侧重置信分布，JRL 侧重 draft/target 的相对能力评估。
summary.experiments:
文中明确给出的数字：在 MathVista 上，JRL 路由达到 2.41× 加速，并且“略微超过更强的 target model”。此外作者在 MathVerse 等数据上展示 token-probability routing 与准确率相关性不成立（Fig.2 a/b），以及特殊 token 路由对正负轨迹采样分布敏感。
由于你提供的全文片段未包含完整实验表，draft/target 的具体模型规格、不同阈值下的 cost-accuracy 曲线、以及在更多基准上的稳定性需要到实验章节核对。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可，优先抓三块：
- Sec.2 的失败分析（为什么 token 概率与准确率在多模态长推理下脱钩；为什么特殊 token 路由对数据分布敏感）。
- DRL/JRL 的 reward 与训练细节（评分信号如何定义、如何避免学成“长度/格式”代理）。
- MathVista 的 cost-accuracy 曲线与路由阈值敏感性。预计 30–45 分钟能把方法与主要结论读清楚。

summary_en.core_problem: How to obtain a reliable, early difficulty/solvability signal for multimodal visual reasoning so that queries can be proactively routed between a small draft model and a large target model before generating long chains-of-thought, avoiding both post-hoc token-probability heuristics and SFT-based special-token routing that is sensitive to trajectory sampling.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency/routing paper rather than pretraining. The pretraining-relevant takeaway is the framing of “instance difficulty / model suitability” as a learnable rating signal trained with RL, produced before generation. Similar signals could potentially inform curriculum sampling, compute-aware training, or data-conditioned routing (e.g., MoE/early-exit) at training time, but that is not the paper’s main focus.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They propose Proactive Routing Paradigm (PRP), making routing decisions at the start of generation.
- Draft Rating Learning (DRL): trains the draft model to output a fine-grained solvability/confidence distribution for an input without generating reasoning steps.
- Joint Rating Learning (JRL): additionally predicts the target model’s suitability/expected benefit, enabling routing based on both models’ strengths rather than only the draft’s uncertainty.
- Training uses a GRPO-style RL procedure (details depend on the full paper: reward definition, sampling, and stabilization).
- Inference uses score-based, multi-stage routing/selection strategies: DRL leverages confidence distributions; JRL leverages joint draft/target capability estimates.
summary_en.experiments:
A concrete number stated: on MathVista, JRL achieves 2.41× speedup while slightly outperforming the stronger target model. They also provide diagnostic evidence (e.g., on MathVerse) that mean token probability is not monotonically correlated with accuracy in multimodal long reasoning, and that special-token routing is sensitive to the distribution of correct/incorrect trajectories.
The excerpt does not include full result tables; you should verify model sizes, routing thresholds, and cost–accuracy trade-off curves in the experiments section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim with focus:
- The failure analysis section explaining why token-probability routing breaks in multimodal long reasoning and why special-token routing is data-sensitive.
- The DRL/JRL training objective and reward design (to ensure the rating is not a proxy for length/format).
- The MathVista cost–accuracy curves and threshold sensitivity. About 30–45 minutes for a solid pass.

recommendation.zh: 看 cost-accuracy frontier 和失败路由分析；若 solvability 估计干净，可借鉴到推理计算分配。
recommendation.en: Read the cost-accuracy frontier and routing failures; if solvability is estimated cleanly, it informs test-time compute allocation.

paper.title: Can MLLMs Critique Like Humans? Evaluating Open-Ended Aesthetic Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Open-ended aesthetic critique is a challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs): unlike multiple-choice aesthetic benchmarks, it has no single correct answer, and most aesthetic evaluation has measured models against numeric scores rather than the written critiques people actually give. We evaluate MLLM critiques against ranked human references and ask whether they are close to human ones. Using the Reddit Photo Critique Dataset, we score five open-weight MLLMs against multiple ranked

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型的美学评估多依赖数值分数或多选基准，缺乏对人类开放式书面批评的对齐评估，且常用参考相似度指标存在误导性。
summary.importance: 属于评测方法分析贡献，系统拆解了MLLM开放式美学批评的评测维度（人设、提示、长度控制等），揭示了常用评测指标的系统性缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 基于Reddit照片批评数据集，设计6种prompt条件（拆解人设、方面提示、长度控制、单/多步生成），加入错误图片的grounding对照组，用词汇、学习型、嵌入余弦三类指标对比5种开源MLLM与人类排序参考的对齐度。
summary.experiments: 评测5种开源MLLM，结果显示：参考相似度指标会高估对齐度，严格词汇/学习指标与人类批评仅弱对齐，粗嵌入余弦仅能检测表层主题重叠。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing aesthetic evaluations of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) mostly rely on numeric scores or multiple-choice benchmarks, lacking alignment assessment with human open-ended written critiques, and common reference-based similarity metrics are misleading.
summary_en.importance: Evaluation methodology analysis contribution; systematically decomposes evaluation dimensions for MLLM open-ended aesthetic critique (persona, prompts, length control, etc.) and reveals systematic flaws in commonly used evaluation metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses the Reddit Photo Critique Dataset, designs 6 prompt conditions (disentangling persona framing, aspect hinting, length control, single/multi-pass generation), adds an image-grounding control with wrong photographs, and compares alignment of 5 open-weight MLLMs to ranked human references via lexical, learned, and embedding cosine metrics.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 5 open-weight MLLMs; results show reference-based similarity metrics overestimate alignment, strict lexical/learned metrics only weakly align with human critiques, and coarse embedding cosine only detects superficial topical overlap.

recommendation.zh: 多模态评测的弱信号工作，仅需关注摘要中关于参考相似度指标误导性的结论，无需阅读正文。
recommendation.en: Weak signal for multimodal evaluation; only note the conclusion on misleading reference similarity metrics in the abstract, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Staying VIGILant: Mitigating Visual Laziness via Counterfactual Visual Alignment in MLLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) extend large language models (LLMs) with visual perception, enabling joint reasoning over images and text. Despite inheriting strong reasoning capabilities from LLMs, they remain prone to hallucinations that contradict their visual inputs. Mechanistic studies indicate that this weakness stems from visual laziness: MLLMs encode the correct visual evidence internally, but overly rely on strong language priors during response. Existing alignment methods, suc

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 MLLM 对视觉输入“看见但不用”的问题。模型内部可能已经编码了正确视觉证据，但解码时仍被语言先验主导，产生与图像矛盾的回答。标准 DPO 只优化最终文本偏好，可能奖励由文本捷径得到的正确答案，因此不能稳定压制 visual laziness。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 VLM post-training 和 native multimodal alignment 有启发。它把多模态幻觉从“感知失败”进一步拆成“视觉证据是否参与了生成决策”的问题。这个视角比单纯做更大偏好数据或更强 judge 更接近训练目标本身：如果模型在遮掉视觉信息后仍然同样自信，那么正确输出也可能不是视觉 grounded 的。对预训练研究的间接价值在于，它提供了一种衡量和训练跨模态信息使用的目标，可用于检查视觉 token、视觉编码器和 LLM 解码过程之间是否真的形成因果耦合。
summary.technical_approach: VIGIL 的核心做法是在偏好优化中加入 counterfactual visual alignment。训练时构造一个 blind state：通过 masking visual attention，让模型无法访问视觉证据，只保留文本指令。然后比较 seeing state 与 blind state 下的响应分布，最大化两者之间的 Visual Information Gain。这样做的目标不是简单让模型更偏好 winning answer，而是要求 winning answer 的置信度来自图像条件；如果模型在看不见图像时仍然对答案很自信，就会被惩罚。与标准 DPO 相比，VIGIL 约束了“答案如何得到”，而不只约束“答案是否被偏好”。与引入外部工具或模块化视觉系统不同，它不改模型结构；与在线 RL 视觉 token 选择不同，它是 offline 训练，计算和稳定性成本更低。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 VIGIL 在 7B 到 72B 的不同 MLLM 架构上都有稳定收益，且更强、更大的基座模型收益更明显。一个重要结果是数据效率：只使用对比基线 25% 的偏好数据，就能达到或接近竞争性方法的表现。作者还观察到 zero-shot referring expression comprehension 提升，且没有使用显式 bounding box 监督，说明这种反事实视觉约束可能促使模型形成更好的空间 grounding。由于给定全文片段没有完整表格，具体 benchmark 分数和逐项提升幅度不宜过度外推；可确认的实验结论是跨规模有效、数据更省、并带来一定的空间定位泛化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries 中对 visual laziness 的概率解释：标准 DPO 为什么会强化语言先验，以及 blind state 为什么能暴露这种 shortcut。方法部分需要关注 Visual Information Gain 的定义、blind attention mask 的实现位置、VIGIL loss 与 DPO loss 的组合方式。实验部分优先看三类结果：25% 数据效率对比、7B–72B 跨架构扩展、zero-shot referring expression 的无框监督提升。若只关心基座预训练，可把它当作一种跨模态信息利用诊断目标，而不是普通幻觉修复方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses visual laziness in multimodal LLMs: the model may encode the relevant visual evidence, yet still rely on language priors during decoding and produce answers that contradict the image. Standard DPO optimizes preference over final text outputs, so it can reward correct-looking answers that were obtained through textual shortcuts rather than visual grounding.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to multimodal post-training and to the broader question of whether visual tokens causally influence generation. Its useful contribution is the shift from outcome-only alignment to evidence-sensitive alignment. If a model remains confident after visual evidence is removed, then even a correct answer may not be visually grounded. This gives a concrete training and diagnostic signal for studying the coupling among the visual encoder, visual tokens, and the LLM decoder.
summary_en.technical_approach: VIGIL introduces counterfactual visual alignment into preference optimization. During training, it constructs a blind state by masking visual attention, preventing the model from using image evidence while preserving the text instruction. The model is then optimized to increase the Visual Information Gain between the normal seeing state and this blind counterfactual state. The intended effect is to make high-confidence preferred responses depend on the visual input. Cases where the model remains confident without the image are treated as blind-confidence failures. Compared with DPO, the method constrains how the answer is derived, not only whether the final text is preferred. Compared with tool-based or modular perception systems, it does not change the architecture. Compared with online RL for visual token selection, it is an offline objective and should be easier to train stably.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports consistent improvements across MLLMs from 7B to 72B parameters, with larger gains on stronger foundation models. A notable data-efficiency result is that VIGIL can match competitive baselines using only 25% of their preference data. The authors also report improved zero-shot referring-expression comprehension without explicit bounding-box supervision, suggesting that the counterfactual visual constraint can encourage spatial grounding. The provided text does not include full benchmark tables, so exact per-benchmark deltas should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus first on the Introduction and Preliminaries, especially the explanation of why DPO can reinforce language-prior shortcuts. Then read the method section for the definition of Visual Information Gain, the implementation of the visual-attention mask, and how the VIGIL term is combined with the preference loss. In the experiments, prioritize the 25% data-efficiency comparison, the 7B-to-72B scaling results, and the zero-shot referring-expression analysis. For foundation-model researchers, the most useful angle is its role as a training objective and diagnostic for cross-modal evidence use, not merely as a hallucination mitigation recipe.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态预训练对齐的研究员可重点看其反事实视觉约束的设计，§3的几何约束公式可直接借鉴到预训练损失函数中。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on multimodal pretraining alignment should focus on its counterfactual visual constraint design; the geometric loss in §3 can be directly adapted to pretraining objectives.

paper.title: Towards a Dynamic and Fixed-budget Memory Bank for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Currently, streaming video understanding is still a daunting task for existing \emph{multimodal large language models} (MLLMs). Its difficulties not only lie in handling the ever-increasing video frames, but also in the unpredictability of future video content and input instructions. In this paper, we study this task from the perspective of constructing a dynamic but fixed-budget memory bank, and propose a novel and training-free approach termed \emph{\textbf{CausalMem}}. CausalMem is dedicated

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是流式视频理解中的固定预算记忆问题：视频帧持续增长，但多模态大模型的上下文和显存预算有限，如何在线保留最有信息量的视觉 token。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理侧系统/算法改进，而且是 training-free 方案。对做长上下文、多模态 KV/记忆压缩的人有一点参考，但它不直接触及基座预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 CausalMem，用一个动态但固定容量的 memory bank 在线更新视频表示。核心做法是估计视觉 token 冗余度，并通过 online semantic basis 建模当前视频流的主语义方向，再决定哪些 token 被保留、替换或压缩。整体不需要额外训练，属于插拔式推理增强模块。
summary.experiments: 方法被接到 LLaVA-OneVision 和 Qwen2.5-VL 上做 streaming video understanding。摘要强调在有限 memory 下提升信息保留和理解效果，但没有给出具体 benchmark、预算设置和提升幅度。从摘要看，更像工程上合理的 memory selection 策略，而不是会改变建模范式的结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles fixed-budget memory management for streaming video understanding, where video frames keep growing but MLLMs have limited context and memory budgets.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time systems/algorithm contribution, specifically a training-free memory mechanism. It may be mildly relevant for people working on long-context multimodal inference, but it does not directly inform foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, CausalMem, maintains a dynamic yet fixed-size memory bank for online video processing. It estimates redundancy among visual tokens and updates memory using an online semantic basis that tracks the principal semantics of the observed stream, deciding what to keep or replace under a fixed budget.
summary_en.experiments: CausalMem is applied to LLaVA-OneVision and Qwen2.5-VL for streaming video understanding. The abstract claims improved information retention and downstream understanding under limited memory, but does not provide concrete benchmarks, budgets, or gains. From the abstract, it looks more like a sensible engineering heuristic than a result that changes modeling assumptions.

recommendation.zh: 典型推理侧 memory 管理，和 pretrain 关系很弱；如果你在做长视频/多模态 serving，只看 memory update 规则，别投入太多时间。
recommendation.en: This is a standard inference-time memory-management paper with weak pretraining relevance; only skim the memory update rule if you care about long-video or multimodal serving.

paper.title: Omni-Perception Policy Optimization for Multimodal Emotion Reasoning
paper.abstract: We find that current emotion-oriented Omni-MLLMs still lack reliable omni-modal perception: they (i) underutilize multimodal cues in their reasoning trajectories and (ii) exhibit unfaithful behavior, often hallucinating modality-specific statements from other modalities. Building on these insights, we propose OPPO (Omni-Perception Policy Optimization), a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly optimizes multimodal perception. First, an Omni-Perception Reward decomposes ground-truth reas

summary.core_problem: 当前面向情感任务的多模态大模型在多模态情感推理中存在“多模态线索利用率低”和“跨模态幻觉导致的推理忠实度不足”两个核心感知缺陷。
summary.importance: 该工作提出的分模态专属奖励、反事实掩码约束模态相关token的RL设计思路，可迁移到通用多模态模型的感知对齐训练中；同时其基于单模态掩码的忠实度评测方法，可为多模态预训练的对齐质量诊断提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出GRPO风格的RL框架OPPO，包含两个核心模块：1）全感知奖励：将标注推理拆解为视觉、声学、情感三类细粒度线索，通过语义相似度计算模型推理链对各类线索的覆盖度，按覆盖度发放奖励，倒逼模型显式还原多模态证据；2）全感知损失：构造单模态掩码的反事实输入，仅对描述模态专属证据的token施加KL惩罚，要求对应模态被掩码时这些token的分布显著变化，抑制跨模态幻觉。此外构建了MEP-Bench诊断集，从线索利用率、推理忠实度两个维度评估模型感知能力。
summary.experiments: 基于5k条MER-Caption+数据做SFT，其余用于RL训练。在MER-UniBench、MME-Emotion上取得最优表现，在MEP-Bench上，多模态线索召回率（基线约50%）、单模态掩码下视觉（基线35.0%~54.2%）和音频（基线26.0%~30.0%）探针准确率均有一致提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言中MEP-Bench的构造逻辑、方法部分的两个RL核心模块设计，无需深究情感领域的具体任务细节。预计阅读时间15~20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current emotion-oriented omnichannel multimodal LLMs have two core perception flaws in multimodal emotion reasoning: low utilization of multimodal cues in reasoning trajectories, and insufficient reasoning faithfulness caused by cross-modal hallucination of modality-specific statements.
summary_en.importance: The proposed RL design ideas — modality-specific rewards and counterfactual mask-based constraints on modality-relevant tokens — can be transferred to perception alignment training for general multimodal models. Its faithfulness evaluation method based on unimodal masking also provides a reference for diagnosing alignment quality in multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: A GRPO-style RL framework named OPPO is proposed, with two core components: 1) Omni-Perception Reward: Decompose annotated reasoning into three fine-grained cue categories (visual, acoustic, emotional), calculate the coverage of each cue category by the model's reasoning chain via semantic similarity, and assign rewards proportional to coverage to force the model to explicitly recover multimodal evidence. 2) Omni-Perception Loss: Construct counterfactual inputs with unimodal masking, apply KL divergence penalty only to tokens describing modality-specific evidence, requiring their distributions to shift significantly when the corresponding modality is masked to suppress cross-modal hallucination. A diagnostic benchmark MEP-Bench is also built to evaluate model perception from two dimensions: cue utilization and reasoning faithfulness.
summary_en.experiments: 5k samples from MER-Caption+ are used for SFT, and the rest for RL training. The model achieves top performance on MER-UniBench and MME-Emotion, with consistent improvements on MEP-Bench: multimodal cue recall (baselines ~50%), unimodal masked probe accuracy for visual (baselines 35.0–54.2%) and audio (baselines 26.0–30.0%) questions all rise noticeably.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the MEP-Bench construction logic in the introduction and the design of the two core RL modules in the method section. No need to dive into domain-specific details of emotion tasks. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 模态特定token的KL惩罚思路对多模态预训练的跨模态对齐目标设计有参考，仅看§3.2的损失设计即可
recommendation.en: The KL penalty on modality-specific tokens provides reference for multimodal pretraining alignment objective design, check §3.2 loss design only

paper.title: Mind the Heads: Topological Representation Alignment for Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Representation alignment has emerged as an effective approach to improve Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by regularizing their internal representations toward those of an external vision encoder. However, existing methods typically align a fixed layer of the language backbone, overlooking the fine-grained structure of Transformer models. In this work, we propose Head-Wise Representation Alignment (HeRA), a method that enforces cross-modal alignment at the level of individual attention h

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是 MLLM 内部视觉-语言表示对齐过粗的问题。已有方法通常选择语言模型某一层的整体 hidden state 去对齐外部视觉编码器，但 Transformer 的表征并不是按“层”均匀组织的，不同 attention head 可能承载不同程度的跨模态结构。论文关心的是：视觉能力不足是否可以通过更细粒度地约束这些 head 的局部几何结构来改善，而不是继续只靠扩大数据、模型或后训练。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接贡献不在文本 LM，而在 VLM/MLLM 的统一表示训练接口。它把 representation alignment 从 feature matching 推向 topology matching：不要求语言侧向量逐点接近视觉侧向量，而是要求样本之间的局部邻域关系一致。这一点对 multimodal pretrain 有启发，因为 MLLM 常常是在已有 LLM 上接入视觉模块，强行对齐特征值可能破坏语言模型已有组织；对齐局部结构更像一种软约束，可能更适合在保留语言能力的同时补视觉感知短板。贡献量级属于方法性增量，但选 head 的诊断思路比较清楚。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 HeRA，即 Head-Wise Representation Alignment。核心流程有三步。第一，用外部 teacher vision encoder 提取图像表示，用语言模型内部不同 attention head 的表示作为候选语言侧表示。第二，用 Mutual K-Nearest Neighbor, MKNN, 衡量两侧表示的局部邻域是否一致。MKNN 不比较绝对坐标，而比较一个样本在两个表征空间里的近邻集合是否相互匹配。第三，不是选择最已经对齐的 head，而是选择最不对齐的 head 加入对比式 alignment loss。这个设计有明确取舍：已经对齐的 head 再施加强约束收益有限，还可能干扰原有功能；低对齐 head 更可能是跨模态瓶颈，适合用额外损失修正。训练目标是在原有 autoregressive token NLL 之外，加入一个可微的拓扑对齐代理目标，让被选中的 head 学到与视觉 teacher 相近的局部结构。它区别于固定层对齐，也区别于直接 MSE/feature regression，因为后者容易把语言模型表示拉向视觉编码器的坐标系，冲突更强。
summary.experiments: 实验放在 LLaVA 类框架下，覆盖多个 MLLM，并在 18 个视觉-语言 benchmark 上评估。论文报告 HeRA 在更依赖视觉感知的任务上收益更稳定，包括物体存在性、计数、空间关系、密集视觉信息解析等场景；普通 VQA 能力没有明显牺牲，部分设置还有提升。另一个观察是 hallucination 有下降，解释是拓扑对齐降低了模型只依赖语言先验补全答案的倾向。给出的材料没有包含完整表格和逐项数值，因此不应只看平均分；更应关注不同 head 选择策略、不同层/头的 MKNN 分布、以及 hallucination benchmark 上的分项变化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看三处：一是方法部分里 MKNN 如何从诊断指标转成训练损失；二是 head selection 的消融，尤其是 least-aligned heads 为什么优于 most-aligned 或 random heads；三是视觉中心任务与 hallucination 评测结果。若只关心预训练启发，可以跳过常规 VQA 榜单细节，把注意力放在“在已有 LLM 组织结构上施加跨模态约束”的设计取舍。这个方向值得深挖的问题是：head-level 拓扑对齐是否能扩展到更早期的 native multimodal pretraining，而不是只在 LLaVA 式后接视觉模块上生效。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a granularity problem in representation alignment for MLLMs. Prior work usually aligns a fixed layer-level hidden state of the language backbone to an external vision encoder. This ignores the fact that Transformer representations are organized unevenly across attention heads. The paper asks whether visual-language alignment can be improved by targeting the specific heads whose local geometry is poorly aligned with the visual teacher.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance is to multimodal pretraining and adaptation rather than text-only LM pretraining. The useful idea is to align topology instead of raw features. In an MLLM built on a pretrained LLM, forcing hidden states to match a vision encoder coordinate-by-coordinate can interfere with the language model’s existing structure. Preserving local neighborhood relations is a softer constraint and may be a better fit for improving perception while retaining language behavior. The contribution is a focused methodological improvement, with a clear diagnostic-and-training loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: HeRA, or Head-Wise Representation Alignment, first measures alignment between individual attention-head representations and a teacher vision encoder using Mutual K-Nearest Neighbor alignment. MKNN compares whether samples share similar local neighborhoods in the two representation spaces, rather than comparing vector coordinates directly.
