summary.importance: 对预训练和中期训练的启发在于，它把视觉 token 也纳入同一个 next-token prediction 目标，而不是引入额外解码器、重建头或第二次 forward。这个方向比较干净：不改架构，只改监督位置和标签构造。它说明 MLLM 的视觉 token logits 已经包含可读语义，可以被转化为训练信号。对 native multimodal LM、视觉 tokenizer 监督、OCR-heavy 数据配比和多模态 annealing 都有参考意义。不过工作主要集中在 fine-grained visual understanding 和 OCR 场景，属于 skim 级别。
summary.technical_approach: DV-SFT 的核心做法是为视觉 token 构造文本标签，然后在视觉 token 的 logits 上直接施加 next-token prediction loss。作者利用一个观察：端到端训练后的 MLLM 在视觉 token 位置也会产生词表分布，top logits 往往对应局部 patch 中的物体、属性或文字。基于这个现象，方法用离线流程生成 token-level vision labels，特别选择 OCR 场景作为可控测试床，因为图像中的文字和文本标签天然可对齐。训练时不增加视觉解码器，不做额外 forward，也不改变模型结构；视觉 token 和文本 token 共享语言模型词表与交叉熵目标。与 next-visual-token prediction 或像素重建不同，它监督的是语义词，而不是低层视觉信号；与表示蒸馏不同，它直接作用在模型最终词表 logits 上，训练信号更接近下游问答所需的语义空间。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖八个 benchmark，包括文档理解、图表理解、OCR 和通用 VQA，例如 SQuAD、DocVQA、TextVQA、ChartQA、OCRBench 等类型任务。主要结果是 DV-SFT 相比标准 SFT 在细粒度文字读取、文档/图表问答和 OCR 相关任务上有稳定收益，同时没有依赖额外模块。正文可见部分没有提供具体数值，但实验设计包含与标准 SFT 的对比，以及用于确认收益来源的分析：改进来自更精细的视觉表示，而不是单纯增加训练数据或改变推理流程。阅读时应核对主结果表、视觉 token label 的消融、loss 权重消融，以及通用 VQA 是否出现退化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。先看 Preliminaries 中 visual logits 的定义，因为这是方法成立的前提；再看 Direct Vision Supervision 的标签构造流程，重点理解 OCR 文本如何映射到视觉 patch token；然后看训练目标，确认视觉 token loss 与普通文本 LM loss 如何合并。实验部分重点看三类消融：是否需要精确 token-level 标签、视觉 loss 权重如何影响 OCR 与通用 VQA、以及相对标准 SFT 的增益是否集中在文字密集任务。若关注多模态预训练目标设计，这项工作比结果数字更值得关注的是“把视觉 token 投到词表监督”的训练接口。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a training-signal gap in MLLMs. Standard end-to-end training applies explicit loss only to text tokens, while visual tokens are optimized only indirectly as context. This weakens fine-grained visual grounding, especially for OCR, documents, and charts where local text matters.
summary_en.importance: The pretraining relevance lies in the supervision interface. DV-SFT applies the same next-token prediction objective to visual-token positions, instead of adding a decoder, a reconstruction head, or extra forward passes. It treats visual-token logits as a semantic space that can be supervised with words. This is useful for thinking about native multimodal pretraining, visual tokenizer supervision, OCR-heavy data mixtures, and mid-training objectives. The scope is still mostly fine-grained visual understanding, so it is a skim-level paper rather than a core pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: DV-SFT builds explicit text labels for visual tokens and applies cross-entropy loss to the logits produced at those visual-token positions. The method relies on an empirical observation: after end-to-end MLLM training, visual-token logits often contain interpretable words corresponding to the local patch content, such as objects, attributes, or text strings. The paper uses OCR-centric data as a controlled setting because image regions and textual labels can be aligned more directly. An offline label-construction pipeline assigns words to visual tokens, and training then combines the usual text-token language-modeling loss with a visual-token loss over the same vocabulary. Unlike next-visual-token prediction or pixel reconstruction, the target is semantic text rather than low-level image content. Unlike representation distillation, the loss acts directly on the model’s output vocabulary distribution and requires no architectural changes.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover eight benchmarks spanning document understanding, chart understanding, OCR, and general VQA, including tasks in the style of SQuAD, DocVQA, TextVQA, ChartQA, and OCRBench. The reported trend is that DV-SFT consistently improves OCR-heavy and fine-grained visual understanding tasks over standard SFT while keeping the model architecture and inference path unchanged. The visible excerpt does not include exact numerical gains, but the experimental narrative emphasizes that the improvements come from refined visual representations rather than auxiliary modules or additional inference computation. The key results to verify are the main comparison against standard SFT, label-quality ablations, visual-loss weight ablations, and any trade-off on general VQA.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the definition of visual logits, since it is the premise of the method. Then read the Direct Vision Supervision section to understand how OCR-derived words are mapped to visual patch tokens. Check the objective to see how the visual-token loss is combined with the normal text-token loss. In the experiments, focus on whether the gains concentrate on text-rich visual tasks, how sensitive the method is to label construction, and whether general VQA performance is preserved. For multimodal pretraining researchers, the reusable idea is the training interface: supervising visual tokens through the shared language vocabulary.

recommendation.zh: 视觉token显式监督的思路对多模态统一预训练的对齐损失设计有启发，只需看方法部分的监督构造逻辑即可。
recommendation.en: The idea of explicit supervision for visual tokens provides insight for alignment loss design in unified multimodal pretraining; only the supervision construction logic in the method section needs to be read.

paper.title: Prism: A Plug-in Reproducible Infrastructure for Scalable Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve versatility by reformulating diverse tasks into a unified instruction-following framework via instruction tuning. However, real-world deployment requires continuous adaptation to emerging tasks, motivating Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). Despite its growing importance, current MCIT research is hindered by severe engineering bottlenecks. Existing methods are typically implemented by directly modifying the base MLLM codebase, which i

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型持续指令微调研究中代码侵入性强、方法难复现、不同策略难公平比较的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是研究基础设施，而非新的预训练或多模态建模方法。它面向 Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning，将算法实现从底座 MLLM 代码中解耦，有助于降低复现实验成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Prism，一个可插拔、可复现的 MCIT 代码库。核心做法是使用轻量 plugin registration 机制，让新的持续学习或指令微调策略作为独立插件接入，而不直接修改底座 MLLM 代码。这样可以复用相同 backbone、数据接口和训练流程，减少方法特定工程差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调 Prism 支持 scalable MCIT research，但未提供具体模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 列表或性能提升数字。其主要评估对象应是实现成本、复现性和不同 MCIT 策略的可比较性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses engineering friction in multimodal continual instruction tuning, where methods often require invasive changes to the base MLLM codebase.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is infrastructure rather than a new multimodal pretraining method. It aims to make MCIT experiments more reproducible and comparable by decoupling algorithms from backbone implementations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Prism is a plug-in codebase for scalable MCIT research. A lightweight plugin registration mechanism lets new continual tuning strategies be added as independent plugins without modifying the underlying MLLM implementation. This keeps the backbone, data interface, and training loop shared across methods.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes scalable and reproducible MCIT support, but does not provide model sizes, training data scale, baseline lists, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation focus is implementation overhead, reproducibility, and fair comparison across MCIT methods.

recommendation.zh: 基础设施型论文，做 MLLM continual tuning 可备查；对预训练方法没有新信号。
recommendation.en: An infrastructure paper worth bookmarking for MLLM continual tuning; it does not add a new signal for pretraining research.

paper.title: DynFrame: Adaptive Reasoning-Driven Multimodal Framework with Dynamic Frame Augmentation for Complex Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Recent video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly couple step-by-step reasoning with on-demand visual evidence retrieval, allowing models to revisit relevant video segments during inference. However, two structural gaps remain in existing thinking-with-video systems. (i) Sampling density is not a learnable decision: existing methods may let the model decide where to look, but the per-window frame rate is largely fixed. As a result, fine-grained evidence is often recovered throug

summary.core_problem: 现有视频多模态大模型的帧采样密度固定、检索与生成的优化信号未拆分，导致复杂视频推理时检索开销大、训练难度高。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将采样密度作为可学习token融入自回归流程，拆分了检索与生成阶段的监督信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DynFrame框架，在自回归生成中直接输出时间窗口与采样密度token，独立优化检索动作与答案生成两条轨迹的优势信号。
summary.experiments: 未披露具体模型参数量与训练数据规模，在复杂视频理解基准上验证了采样密度自适应可降低检索次数与上下文长度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video MLLMs use fixed frame sampling density and shared optimization signals for retrieval and generation, leading to high retrieval overhead and training difficulty in complex video reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first to model sampling density as learnable tokens in autoregressive pass and decouple supervision signals for retrieval and generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DynFrame framework, which emits temporal window and sampling density as native tokens during autoregressive generation, and optimizes advantage signals for retrieval action and answer generation trajectories separately.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model size and training data scale not disclosed. Verified on complex video understanding benchmarks that adaptive sampling density reduces retrieval calls and context length.

recommendation.zh: 多模态推理流程的小改进，检索与生成监督拆分的思路对通用Agent的动作-回答信用分配有微弱参考，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Minor improvement to multimodal reasoning pipeline. The idea of decoupling retrieval and generation supervision has weak reference for general agent action-answer credit assignment; no need for in-depth reading.

paper.title: AgentHijack: Benchmarking Computer Use Agent Robustness to Common Environment Corruptions
paper.abstract: Autonomous computer use agents that powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are emerging as capable assistants for completing complex digital workflows. However, real-world execution environments are far from ideal: pop-ups, resolution changes, and competing applications frequently interfere with agent perception and control. We introduce AgentHijack, a benchmark designed to evaluate the robustness of computer-use agents under common corruptions, where the uncertainties in dynamic en

summary.core_problem: 现有计算机操作Agent的评测基准（如OSWorld、WebArena）仅在干净理想的环境中评估任务成功率，但真实部署环境中频繁出现弹窗、分辨率变化、网络错误等非对抗性环境干扰，导致Agent性能大幅下降。此前缺乏对这种常见环境扰动下鲁棒性的系统性评测框架。
summary.importance: 首个专门针对GUI操作Agent在常见环境扰动下鲁棒性的评测基准，填补了实验室评测与真实部署之间的gap。对于预训练研究的启示在于：Agent在环境噪声下的失效模式（不稳定的grounding、执行计划受干扰、无法检测环境错误）可为多模态大模型预训练和mid-training的数据增强策略提供方向。
summary.technical_approach: 在OSWorld框架基础上，设计了9种可配置的常见环境扰动类型（包括弹窗、分辨率变化、网络错误、误触干扰等），构建了总计3,321个评测任务。同时提出了AgentHijack-Agent架构：整合了grounding能力增强的动作生成器和负责行为总结与环境检查的onlooker模块，通过数据增强的group relative policy optimization提升Agent在多样环境中的grounding能力。
summary.experiments: 评测了多种开源（Dubey et al. 2024, Bai et al. 2025）、闭源（Achiam et al. 2023, Anthropic 2025）和专用（Qin et al. 2025）MLLM-based Agent基线。结果表明当前Agent在轻微环境扰动下即出现显著性能下降，主要失效模式为grounding不稳定、执行计划易受干扰、无法检测环境错误。所提AgentHijack-Agent在一定程度上缓解了这些问题，但未完全解决。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节（基准构建：9种扰动类型的定义和方法论）和第5节（实验结果，特别是各Agent的失效模式分析）。第4节的Agent架构是附加贡献，非核心。预计阅读时间约20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 未在提供内容中明确标注机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing computer-use agent benchmarks (OSWorld, WebArena, etc.) evaluate task success only in clean, idealized environments, but real-world deployments face frequent non-adversarial environmental corruptions (pop-ups, resolution changes, network errors) that cause substantial performance degradation. No systematic evaluation framework for this type of corruption robustness previously existed.
summary_en.importance: The first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate GUI agent robustness under common environmental corruptions, filling the gap between lab evaluation and real-world deployment. For pre-training researchers, the documented failure modes (unstable grounding, disrupted execution plans, inability to detect environmental errors) can inform data augmentation strategies for MLLM pre-training and mid-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on the OSWorld framework, designing 9 configurable common corruption types (pop-ups, resolution changes, network errors, accidental touch interference, etc.) to create 3,321 total evaluation tasks. Also proposes AgentHijack-Agent architecture: integrates an action generator with enhanced grounding and an onlooker module for behavioral summarization and environment checking, using data-augmented group relative policy optimization to improve agent grounding in diverse environments.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated various open-source (Dubey et al. 2024, Bai et al. 2025), closed-source (Achiam et al. 2023, Anthropic 2025), and specialized (Qin et al. 2025) MLLM-based agent baselines. Results show that current agents degrade significantly even under minor corruptions, with primary failure modes being unstable grounding, susceptibility to execution plan interference, and failure to detect environmental errors. The proposed AgentHijack-Agent mitigates but does not fully resolve these issues.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (benchmark construction: 9 corruption types and methodology) and Section 5 (experimental results, especially failure mode analysis). The agent architecture in Section 4 is a secondary contribution. Estimated reading time: ~20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 计算机使用agent鲁棒性的benchmark，对agent评测方向有参考价值但与LLM预训练无直接关联，仅需了解结论。
recommendation.en: Robustness benchmark for computer-use agents; relevant for agent evaluation but not directly tied to LLM pretraining—just note the finding.

paper.title: BigMac: Breaking the Pareto Frontier of Compute and Memory in Multimodal LLM Training
paper.abstract: Training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is challenged by both model and data heterogeneity. Existing systems redesign the training pipeline to address these challenges, but remain bound by a Pareto frontier between compute and memory efficiency, improving one only at the expense of the other. We present BigMac, a new training pipeline for multimodal LLMs. The core idea of BigMac is to elegantly nest the encoder and generator computation into the original LLM pipeline, forming a depende

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态 LLM 训练中视觉/语音等 encoder、生成器与 LLM 主干混合后带来的激活显存和流水线计算效率冲突。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MLLM 训练系统创新。它关注 native multimodal pretraining 的实际瓶颈：模态模块和 LLM 主干的依赖关系不同，直接套文本 LLM pipeline 会在显存和吞吐之间做硬取舍。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BigMac，将 encoder 和 generator 的计算嵌入原有 LLM pipeline，形成 dependency-safe nested pipeline。核心设计是让多模态模块的计算在不破坏 LLM 流水依赖的前提下嵌套执行，从而把 encoder 和 generator 的激活显存复杂度降到 O(1)，同时保持 LLM 部分激活复杂度不变。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称 BigMac 在计算效率上达到无限显存理想设置，同时降低 encoder 和 generator 的激活显存复杂度，但未给出具体集群规模、模型规模、模态类型、吞吐提升或显存节省数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the compute-memory tradeoff in multimodal LLM training when encoders, generators, and the LLM backbone have heterogeneous dependencies.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-system contribution for MLLMs. It targets a practical bottleneck in native multimodal pretraining: multimodal components do not fit cleanly into the pipeline assumptions used for text-only LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: BigMac nests encoder and generator computation inside the original LLM pipeline using a dependency-safe nested pipeline structure. This design reduces activation memory complexity for the encoder and generator to O(1), while leaving the LLM activation memory complexity unchanged and preserving computational efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims computational efficiency comparable to an ideal unlimited-memory setup and O(1) activation memory for the encoder and generator, but it does not provide cluster size, model size, modality mix, throughput numbers, or memory reduction figures.

recommendation.zh: 多模态预训练的系统坑常被低估；只看 pipeline 依赖图和显存复杂度证明，真实性要等吞吐表支撑。
recommendation.en: The systems bottleneck in MLLM pretraining is real; read the dependency graph and memory analysis, then wait for throughput tables before buying the claim.

paper.title: EgoCoT-Bench: Benchmarking Grounded and Verifiable Operation-Centric Chain of Thought Reasoning for MLLMs
paper.abstract: The rapid development of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has led to growing interest in egocentric video understanding, specifically the ability for MLLMs to recognize fine-grained hand-object interactions, track object state changes over time, and reason about manipulative processes in dynamic environments from a first-person perspective. However, existing egocentric video benchmarks suffer from \textbf{limited grounded rationale evaluation}, offering limited support for fine-grained o

summary.core_problem: 现有第一人称视角视频基准缺乏细粒度的可验证推理依据评估，无法有效衡量多模态大模型基于时空证据的操作级链式推理能力。
summary.importance: 提出首个面向可验证操作级CoT推理的第一人称视频基准EgoCoT-Bench，属于多模态推理领域的基准贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 标注351个第一人称视角视频的3172个可验证QA对，分为4个任务组12个子任务，要求模型输出的推理过程与显式时空证据对齐。
summary.experiments: 系统评测现有主流MLLM，发现现有模型在基于视觉证据的操作级CoT推理任务上表现普遍不佳，推理过程与证据对齐度低。
summary.authors_note: 浙江大学团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing egocentric video benchmarks lack fine-grained evaluation of verifiable reasoning rationales, and cannot effectively measure MLLMs' operation-level chain-of-thought reasoning grounded in spatio-temporal evidence.
summary_en.importance: Proposes EgoCoT-Bench, the first egocentric video benchmark for verifiable operation-level CoT reasoning, a benchmark contribution for multimodal reasoning research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Annotates 3,172 verifiable QA pairs across 351 egocentric videos, divided into 4 task groups and 12 sub-tasks, requiring model rationales to align with explicit spatio-temporal evidence.
summary_en.experiments: Systematic evaluation of mainstream MLLMs shows existing models generally underperform on grounded operation-level CoT reasoning, with low alignment between rationales and visual evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Zhejiang University.

recommendation.zh: 多模态第一人称推理的细分基准，可作为MLLM推理能力评估的补充参考，仅需浏览基准设计部分。
recommendation.en: Subdomain benchmark for multimodal egocentric reasoning, can serve as supplementary reference for MLLM reasoning evaluation, only need to skim the benchmark design section.

paper.title: UniVLR: Unifying Text and Vision in Visual Latent Reasoning for Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models are increasingly expected to perform thinking with images, yet existing visual latent reasoning methods still rely on explicit textual chain-of-thought interleaved with visual latent tokens. This interleaved design limits efficiency and keeps reasoning fragmented across separate text and vision channels. We propose UniVLR, a unified visual latent reasoning framework that treats textual reasoning and auxiliary visual evidence as a shared visual workspace. Instead

summary.core_problem: UniVLR 处理的是多模态模型中的视觉 latent reasoning 问题。已有方法通常把显式文本 CoT 和视觉 latent token 交替生成。这样做保留了文本推理通道，但生成仍然很长，且后续文本 token 对早期辅助图像的注意力稀疏、分散，导致图像证据没有稳定参与后续推理。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 VLM 预训练和原生多模态推理有参考价值。它的关键启发是：文本推理不一定要以离散文本 token 的形式留在推理轨迹中，也可以被渲染成视觉对象，与裁剪图、标注图、草图等辅助图像放在同一个视觉画布上，再压缩成视觉 latent token。这个设计把“reasoning trace”从文本序列改造成视觉 latent supervision，连接了 rendered text、视觉 tokenizer、latent reasoning 和多模态统一建模。
summary.technical_approach: UniVLR 采用两阶段训练。第一阶段是 Visual Latent Grounding，用 visual CoT 中的辅助图像作为 latent alignment target，让模型学会自回归地产生有语义的视觉 latent token。第二阶段是 Text–Vision Unified Alignment：把每一步文本推理渲染成图片，并和对应的辅助图像在空间上拼接，形成一个同时包含文字推理、图像证据和布局关系的统一图像；再用视觉编码器提取这个统一图像的表示，作为 latent token 的对齐目标。推理时，模型不再生成显式文本 CoT，而是只生成统一视觉 latent token，最后直接解码自然语言答案。与 interleaved text+vision latent 方法相比，UniVLR 的差异在于它取消了独立文本推理通道，把文本 CoT 转移到视觉通道中，让视觉 encoder 处理 OCR、版面和辅助图像之间的关系。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 V*、HRBench、MME-RealWorld 等偏真实感知和视觉推理的 benchmark，并在 Qwen2.5-VL 等多个 base MLLM 上验证。论文报告 UniVLR 在去掉显式文本 CoT 的情况下，平均准确率比 Monet、LVR、SkiLa 等 interleaved visual latent reasoning 方法高 5.4%，同时生成 token 数减少 15.2 倍。注意力分析显示，统一视觉表示使模型对辅助图像的关注更集中；hidden-state 分布也更一致，说明文本推理内容和辅助图像在共享视觉 latent 空间中对齐得更好。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–40 分钟。优先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解 interleaved 方案与 unified visual workspace 的区别。方法部分重点看两个训练阶段的 target 构造：第一阶段如何从辅助图像得到视觉 latent，第二阶段如何渲染文本推理并与辅助图像拼接。实验部分重点看 token 数减少与准确率提升是否同时成立，以及不同 base MLLM 上是否稳定。需要进一步追问的是：渲染文本进入视觉通道会引入多大分辨率和 OCR 负担；长推理链在视觉画布中如何排版；视觉 latent 的长度、压缩率和错误传播之间如何权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: UniVLR addresses visual latent reasoning in multimodal LLMs. Prior methods usually interleave explicit textual chain-of-thought with visual latent tokens. This keeps a separate text reasoning channel, but it limits efficiency and makes visual evidence weakly integrated: later text tokens often attend sparsely and diffusely to earlier auxiliary images.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to VLM pretraining and native multimodal reasoning. Its useful idea is that textual reasoning does not have to remain as discrete text tokens during inference. It can be rendered as a visual object, spatially composed with crops, annotations, sketches, or diagrams, and compressed into visual latent tokens. This connects rendered-text understanding, visual tokenization, latent reasoning, and unified multimodal modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniVLR uses a two-stage training pipeline. The first stage, Visual Latent Grounding, aligns autoregressively generated visual latent tokens with auxiliary images from visual CoT traces, so the model learns to produce semantically meaningful latent visual representations. The second stage, Text–Vision Unified Alignment, renders each textual reasoning step into an image and spatially concatenates it with the corresponding auxiliary image. The vision encoder representation of this unified image becomes the latent alignment target. At inference time, the model no longer emits explicit textual CoT. It generates only unified visual latent tokens and then decodes the final answer in natural language. The key difference from interleaved text-plus-visual-latent methods is that UniVLR removes the independent text reasoning path and moves the reasoning trace into the visual channel, relying on the vision encoder’s OCR and layout understanding to process both text and visual evidence together.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover V*, HRBench, and MME-RealWorld, with multiple base MLLMs including Qwen2.5-VL. The reported average gain over interleaved visual latent reasoning methods such as Monet, LVR, and SkiLa is 5.4% accuracy, while reducing the number of generated tokens by 15.2x. Attention analysis shows denser and more focused attention to auxiliary images under the unified visual representation. Hidden-state analysis also suggests more coherent latent-token distributions, indicating better alignment between textual reasoning content and auxiliary visual evidence in the shared latent space.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–40 minutes. Start with Figure 1 and Figure 2 to understand the difference between interleaved reasoning and the unified visual workspace. In the method section, focus on how the targets are built in the two stages: auxiliary-image alignment in the first stage, and rendered-text-plus-image alignment in the second stage. In the experiments, check whether accuracy and token reduction improve together, and whether the gains hold across different base MLLMs. The main technical questions are the resolution and OCR burden introduced by rendering text, how long reasoning traces are laid out on the visual canvas, and how latent length, compression ratio, and error propagation are balanced.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“把CoT从文本通道挪走”的训练接口设计；先核对是否只是把监督换成图像渲染，且对比是否公平（同token/同工具）。
recommendation.en: Read for the training interface that removes textual CoT from the inference path; verify it’s not just a supervision-format trick and that baselines are token/tool-budget matched.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: MACS: Modality-Aware Capacity Scaling for Efficient Multimodal MoE Inference
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts Multimodal Large Language Models (MoE MLLMs) suffer from a significant efficiency bottleneck during Expert Parallelism (EP) inference due to the straggler effect. This issue is worsened in the multimodal context, as existing token-count-based load balancing methods fail to address two unique challenges: (1) Information Heterogeneity, where numerous redundant visual tokens are treated equally to semantically critical ones, and (2) Modality Dynamics, where varying visual to text

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是多模态 MoE 模型在 Expert Parallelism 推理时的 straggler 问题，尤其是现有按 token 数量做 capacity 管理的方法在多模态场景下失真。原因有两个：视觉 token 信息密度差异很大，很多 patch 是冗余背景；同时不同任务的图文比例变化很大，固定 capacity 因子会导致资源分配和同步等待都不稳定。论文的目标是在不改训练的前提下，做更贴近真实负载的推理期调度。
summary.importance: 这不是 pretrain 方法论文，而是部署侧的高相关效率工作。对基座研究员的价值主要有两点。第一，它提醒多模态 MoE 的负载并不由 token 数量单独决定，tokenizer 设计、视觉冗余和路由分布会直接影响 EP 推理效率。第二，它提供了一个训练无关的视角：如果推理瓶颈主要来自模态异质性，那么训练时的 load balancing loss 可能也需要从“按 token 均匀”转向“按信息量均匀”。因此它更像对 multimodal MoE 训练目标和系统设计的反向启发，而不是直接改变预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach:
MACS 是一个 training-free 的推理框架，核心由三部分组成。

第一部分是 Entropy-Weighted Load。作者认为视觉 token 的真实“负载价值”不应按 1 个 token 记 1 份，而应按其语义信息量加权。具体做法是：对视觉 token 的特征表示 z 做 softmax，得到分布后计算 Shannon entropy；再在当前图像或 batch 内做 z-score 归一化，最后通过 sigmoid 映射成权重。直觉上，高信息 token 获得更高权重，低信息背景 token 被降权。文本 token 则直接赋满权，因为其语义密度通常更均匀、更高。

第二部分是 Dynamic Modality-Adaptive Capacity。传统方法用固定 capacity factor γ 给每个 expert 设上限，但多模态 batch 的视觉/文本比例波动很大，固定阈值会在图像密集任务和文本密集任务之间来回失配。MACS 根据当前 batch 的模态组成动态调整 expert capacity，使容量预算更贴近实际负载结构，而不是沿用静态 token-count 近似。

第三部分是 Local Semantic Rerouting 与 overflow handling。当某些 expert 超出容量时，方法先尝试在局部做 reroute，把 token 送到语义上相近、且仍有余量的 expert；如果仍无法容纳，再执行 fail-safe drop。这里的设计取舍很明确：相比直接 token drop，它尽量保留高价值 token；相比全局重路由，它控制了额外调度开销，适合推理时在线使用。

与已有 CAI-MoE 一类方法相比，MACS 的区别不在于重新训练 router，而在于把“负载”从粗粒度 token 数量改成模态感知、信息感知的有效负载，并把 capacity 从静态常数改成 batch 自适应变量。
summary.experiments:
从可见全文内容看，作者做了较系统的多模态基准实验，目标是同时验证延迟改善和任务性能保持。实验设置围绕 MoE MLLM 的 EP inference，比较对象包括标准静态 capacity 管理和已有 straggler 缓解方法。论文声称 MACS 在多种 multimodal benchmark 上优于现有方法，并且强调这种收益在视觉 token 冗余高、图文比例波动大的任务上更明显。

不过，当前给出的全文片段没有完整列出具体模型规模、专家数、batch 配置、延迟下降百分比、吞吐提升幅度，也没有看到详细表格中的精确数字。因此能确认的实验结论主要是方向性的：Entropy-Weighted Load 能更准确估计视觉侧有效负载，Dynamic Modality-Adaptive Capacity 能缓解不同任务模态比例变化带来的失配，rerouting 机制则减少了 overflow 时的性能损失。若要做工程判断，需要回到正文实验表，重点核对 latency、throughput、drop ratio 和 benchmark 精度之间的 trade-off。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Method 图和三部分模块定义，理解它到底改了什么：不是改 router 参数，而是改推理期 capacity 估计与 overflow 处理。然后看实验里的 latency/throughput 主表，确认收益是否稳定，以及是否依赖某类视觉任务。接着看消融：去掉 entropy weighting、去掉 dynamic capacity、只保留 rerouting，各自掉多少，能帮助判断哪个模块是真正主因。

有两个地方值得带着问题读。第一，entropy 是否真是视觉 token 语义价值的好 proxy；它可能也会把噪声或不确定性高的 token 误判为重要。第二，batch-level modality adaptation 在在线 serving 场景下是否稳定，尤其是 batch 很小或任务混杂时。预计泛读 15–25 分钟，若要评估是否可落地，需要仔细看实验设置和系统开销分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the straggler effect in Expert Parallel inference for multimodal MoE models. Existing capacity-control methods mostly use raw token counts as the load signal. That assumption breaks in multimodal settings for two reasons: visual tokens are highly heterogeneous in information content, and the image-to-text ratio varies widely across tasks. As a result, static token-count-based capacity allocation misestimates actual expert pressure and amplifies synchronization delays.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant to foundation-model research. It highlights that multimodal MoE load is shaped not only by routing frequency, but also by modality-specific token redundancy and tokenizer granularity. That has implications beyond serving: if inference imbalance is driven by information heterogeneity, then training-time load-balancing objectives based purely on token counts may also be misaligned. So the paper is useful less as a new modeling paradigm and more as a systems signal for how multimodal MoE objectives and tokenization choices interact with deployment efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MACS is a training-free inference framework with three components.

First, Entropy-Weighted Load replaces raw token counts with an information-aware load estimate. For each visual token, the method computes a Shannon entropy score from the token feature after a softmax transformation, normalizes entropy values within the current image or batch, and maps them to semantic weights through a sigmoid function. The intuition is simple: not all visual patches deserve equal capacity. Background or redundant patches should count less than semantically dense ones. Text tokens are assigned full weight because their semantic density is treated as relatively uniform and high.

Second, Dynamic Modality-Adaptive Capacity adjusts expert capacity according to the current batch-level modality composition. Standard methods use a fixed capacity factor gamma, which is brittle when some tasks are image-heavy and others are text-heavy. MACS makes capacity a function of the actual visual/text mix in the batch, so the budget tracks the current workload instead of a static approximation.

Third, Local Semantic Rerouting handles overflow. When an expert exceeds capacity, the framework first attempts to reroute overflow tokens to semantically nearby experts with spare room; only when rerouting fails does it fall back to a safe token drop. This is a practical design choice: it preserves more useful information than direct dropping, while avoiding the overhead of a more expensive global reassignment.

Relative to prior methods such as CAI-MoE, the key shift is not retraining the router but redefining load and capacity at inference time in a modality-aware way.
summary_en.experiments:
From the visible full text, the evaluation is designed to show both latency gains and quality preservation on multimodal benchmarks under EP inference. The paper reports that MACS outperforms existing methods across several multimodal tasks, with larger gains when visual redundancy is high or when modality ratios vary substantially across tasks.

That said, the excerpt does not expose the full quantitative tables. The exact model sizes, number of experts, latency reductions, throughput gains, and quality deltas are not visible here. So the reliable takeaway is directional rather than numeric: entropy-weighted load improves the estimate of effective visual workload, dynamic modality-adaptive capacity reduces mismatch under changing modality ratios, and rerouting lowers the quality loss associated with overflow handling. For an engineering decision, the main tables on latency, throughput, drop rate, and benchmark accuracy need to be checked directly.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the method figure first. The important point is that MACS does not modify router training; it changes inference-time capacity estimation and overflow handling. Then go to the main latency and throughput tables to see whether the gains are consistent across task types or concentrated in image-heavy workloads. After that, inspect the ablations: removing entropy weighting, removing dynamic capacity, or keeping only rerouting should reveal which component drives most of the benefit.

Two questions are worth carrying into the read. First, is entropy really a good proxy for semantic value in visual tokens, or can it overvalue noisy and uncertain patches? Second, how stable is batch-level modality adaptation in realistic serving conditions, especially with small or mixed batches? A quick pass should take 15–25 minutes; a deployment-oriented read needs careful attention to overhead analysis and experimental setup.

recommendation.zh: 多模态MoE推理效率的工程优化，对实际部署有参考价值，但属于推理系统优化而非预训练方法创新，方法部分值得skim。
recommendation.en: Engineering optimization for multimodal MoE inference efficiency, practically useful for deployment but not a pretraining method innovation; skim the method section.

We show that such attacks are governed by a \emph{reconstruction--concealment tradeoff}: the transformed input must hide harmful intent from safety filters while remaining recoverable enough for the victim model to reconstruct the original request. Through a reconstruction analysis of three representative black-box methods

summary.core_problem: 现有基于意图混淆的MLLM越狱攻击无法平衡重构性和隐蔽性的权衡，攻击有效性受限
summary.importance: 方法创新，揭示了越狱攻击的重构-隐蔽权衡规律，提出新的隐蔽感知变体构造攻击方法
summary.technical_approach: 通过移除字符的输入变体平衡隐蔽性和可重构性，贪婪选择低有害关键词对齐、相互多样的变体，结合五种模态感知提示策略构造攻击输入
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体测试的MLLM型号、攻击成功率提升幅度等详细实验结果
summary.authors_note: 来自北卡罗来纳州立大学、浙江大学，无公开知名多模态预训练研究员信息

summary_en.core_problem: Existing intent obfuscation based MLLM jailbreak attacks cannot balance the tradeoff between reconstructability and concealment, leading to limited attack effectiveness
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, reveals the reconstruction-concealment tradeoff of jailbreak attacks, proposes a new concealment-aware variant construction attack method
summary_en.technical_approach: Balance concealment and reconstructability via character-removed input variants, greedily select variants with low harmful keyword alignment and mutual diversity, construct attack inputs combined with five modality-aware prompting strategies
summary_en.experiments: Detailed experimental results such as tested MLLM models and attack success rate improvement are not disclosed in the abstract
summary_en.authors_note: From NC State University, Zhejiang University, no publicly well-known multimodal pretraining researchers are identified

recommendation.zh: MLLM安全攻击的增量工作，仅作为对齐方向的弱信号参考，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Incremental MLLM security attack work, only as weak reference for alignment research, read abstract only

paper.title: Causal Probing for Internal Visual Representations in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Despite the remarkable success of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) across diverse tasks, the internal mechanisms governing how they encode and ground distinct visual concepts remain poorly understood. To bridge this gap, we propose a causal framework based on activation steering to actively probe and manipulate internal visual representations. Through systematic intervention across four visual concept categories, our results reveal a divergence in concept encoding: entities exhibit disti

summary.core_problem: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）如何在内部编码和锚定不同类型的视觉概念（实体、风格、情感、抽象概念），其机制尚不清楚。常规行为评估和相关性分析无法区分模型是依赖真实内部表征还是浅层启发式。
summary.importance: 首次使用因果激活干预（activation steering）系统性研究MLLM中不同视觉概念的编码模式。发现实体概念呈层局部化存储而抽象概念呈全局分布式表征的关键差异，并揭示了模型scaling对抽象概念编码的机制——更大的模型利用增加的深度来逐步编码复杂语义，这解释了scaling带来能力涌现的一个可能原因。对MLLM架构设计和理解视觉-语言对齐机制有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 基于激活转向（activation steering）框架构建因果探测方法：（1）为四类视觉概念（实体、视觉风格、情感、抽象概念）构建配对图像数据集；（2）在每层残差流上提取概念向量（正负样本激活均值差）；（3）通过注入/擦除概念向量来干预推理过程，测量其对模型输出的因果影响；（4）额外引入几何辅助线场景测试视觉逻辑推理的抽象概念边界。
summary.experiments: 在多个MLLM上进行系统实验：（1）实体概念在特定层有明显局部化峰值，支持事实知识以显式键值对存储的假设；抽象概念则全局分布，需要整体干预策略；（2）更大模型会扩展抽象概念的表征分布，利用增加的深度编码复杂语义——这是小模型欠缺的能力；（3）不同概念有特征性层分布：情感集中在中间层，抽象概念偏向末尾层；同模型家族编码模式相似，跨家族则有差异；（4）反向擦除概念向量可抑制显式文本生成，但会触发潜在激活的补偿机制以调和视觉证据；（5）当前MLLM能识别几何辅助线的视觉关系，但缺乏将其作为解题信号的内在机制，揭示了视觉感知与逻辑推理之间的断层。
summary.reading_guide: 重点读§3.1（实体vs抽象概念编码差异和scaling机制解释）和§5（几何辅助线推理实验揭示的MLLM局限性），这两部分给出了最具体的机制性发现。方法部分§2可快速浏览，激活转向的数学证明在附录A。预计阅读时间30-40分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构和作者信息未在文中明确标注。

summary_en.core_problem: How Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) internally encode and ground different types of visual concepts (entities, styles, emotions, abstract concepts) remains poorly understood. Standard behavioral evaluation and correlation analysis cannot distinguish whether models rely on genuine internal representations or shallow heuristics.
summary_en.importance: This is the first work to systematically investigate encoding patterns of diverse visual concepts in MLLMs using causal activation intervention. The key finding—that entity concepts exhibit localized layer storage while abstract concepts show globally distributed representations—and the revealed scaling mechanism (larger models use increased depth to progressively encode complex semantics absent in small models) provides a mechanistic explanation for capability emergence via scaling. This offers useful insights for MLLM architecture design and understanding vision-language alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: A causal probing framework based on activation steering: (1) construct paired image datasets for four visual concept categories; (2) extract concept vectors at each residual stream layer via mean activation difference between positive and negative samples; (3) intervene during inference by injecting or erasing concept vectors to measure causal effects on model output; (4) additionally test abstract concept boundaries in visual logical reasoning using geometric auxiliary lines.
summary_en.experiments: Systematic experiments across multiple MLLMs: (1) Entity concepts show distinct localization peaks at specific layers, supporting the factual-storage-as-key-value-pairs hypothesis; abstract concepts are globally distributed, requiring holistic intervention; (2) Larger models expand representational distribution of abstract concepts, using increased depth to encode complex semantics—a capability deficient in small models; (3) Characteristic layer distributions: emotions concentrate in middle layers, abstract concepts skew toward late layers; encoding patterns are similar within model families but divergent across families; (4) Reverse concept erasure suppresses explicit text generation but triggers compensatory latent activations to reconcile with visual evidence; (5) Current MLLMs can recognize geometric relations of auxiliary lines but lack the intrinsic mechanism to use them as problem-solving signals, exposing a disconnection between visual perception and logical reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3.1 (entity vs. abstract concept encoding divergence and scaling mechanism explanation) and §5 (geometric auxiliary line reasoning experiment revealing MLLM limitations)—these sections contain the most substantive mechanistic findings. Methods §2 can be skimmed; mathematical proof of activation steering is in Appendix A. Estimated reading time: 30–40 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not explicitly stated in the paper.

recommendation.zh: 多模态预训练研究员可重点看§4的scaling规律结论，对分层视觉概念编码设计有直接参考价值
recommendation.en: Multimodal pretrain researchers should focus on §4 scaling law findings, which provide direct reference for hierarchical visual concept encoding design.

paper.title: RetentiveKV: State-Space Memory for Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal KV Cache Eviction
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models face severe challenges in computational efficiency and memory consumption due to the substantial expansion of the visual KV cache when processing long visual contexts. Existing KV cache compression methods typically rely on the "persistence of importance" hypothesis to prune tokens. However, this approach proves fragile in multimodal settings due to two key issues: 1) Visual tokens display "deferred importance," initially exhibiting low salience but becoming pivo

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是多模态长上下文推理中的视觉 KV cache 压缩问题：现有按注意力重要性直接删 token 的方法，容易提前删掉后续才变重要的视觉 token，也会破坏视觉 patch 的空间连续性。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理效率，但对多模态基座研究有一个清楚的提醒：视觉 token 的重要性不像文本 token 那样稳定，早期低注意力不等于后续无用。这个观察会影响高分辨率图像、多图、多帧视频模型的 serving，也会反过来影响视觉 tokenization 和 native multimodal 预训练时对视觉上下文组织方式的设计。贡献量级主要在方法层面：把 KV eviction 从离散删除改成连续状态记忆，用状态空间模型承担被压缩视觉信息的保留和召回。
summary.technical_approach: RetentiveKV 的核心做法是把被淘汰的 KV 不直接丢弃，而是写入一个由状态空间模型维护的连续记忆。它先用文本到视觉 token 的注意力熵估计“未来可能有用但当前还不确定”的视觉信息。高熵表示模型尚未聚焦到少数视觉区域，说明视觉上下文仍有较高不确定性，低注意力 token 不宜被永久删除。随后，方法用 entropy-guided state transition 将这些 token 融入选择性状态。相比简单的 token merging，这种递归状态更新保留了按查询选择历史片段的能力，也更自然地编码位置和空间邻接关系。论文还设计了双状态结构：Visual-Dominant States 主要维护视觉 patch 的空间拓扑，Recall-Oriented States 主要维护长期语义依赖。解码时再通过 Query-Conditioned Retrieval 从状态中重新激活与当前语义相关的信息。区别于 H2O、StreamingLLM 以及多模态场景中按模态比例调节删除率的方法，RetentiveKV 不只改变保留多少 token，而是改变被删 token 的表示形态。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在多个多模态 benchmark 上验证了内存占用和计算开销下降，并强调在存在 delayed visual dependency 的 VQA 类任务上优于传统重要性驱动的 KV pruning。给出的全文片段没有包含完整实验表格，因此不宜补写具体数值。需要重点核查三类结果：一是相同 cache budget 下的准确率保持情况；二是不同视觉 token 长度、图像分辨率和问题类型下的退化曲线；三是状态记忆带来的额外计算是否抵消 KV 减少收益。消融上应关注 attention entropy、dual-state 结构、query-conditioned retrieval 是否分别带来稳定增益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约 25 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 deferred importance 和 visual continuity collapse 的现象分析，这是方法成立的前提。再看 Method 中 entropy-guided retention estimator、state transition、dual-state retrieval 三部分，重点判断它是否真的保留了可查询的信息，而不是只做平滑压缩。实验部分建议直接看不同压缩率下的性能-显存曲线，以及视觉问答、长视觉上下文、多图场景的分项结果。若只关心预训练，可跳读工程实现细节，保留对视觉 token 动态重要性的观察。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV-cache compression for long multimodal inference, where attention-based eviction can discard visual tokens that only become important later and can break the spatial continuity of visual patches.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency paper, but it contains a useful lesson for multimodal foundation models: visual-token importance is less stationary than text-token importance. Low early attention does not necessarily mean a visual token is irrelevant. That matters for high-resolution images, multi-image inputs, and video contexts, and it also feeds back into visual tokenization and native multimodal pretraining design. The main contribution is methodological: replacing hard eviction with a continuous state-space memory that can retain and later reactivate compressed visual information.
summary_en.technical_approach: RetentiveKV does not permanently remove low-importance KV entries. It writes them into a continuous memory maintained by a state-space model. The method first estimates prospective uncertainty using the entropy of text-to-visual attention. High entropy means the model has not yet localized the relevant visual evidence, so currently low-attended visual tokens may still be useful later. These tokens are then absorbed through entropy-guided state transitions. Compared with simple weighted merging, the recursive state update keeps a selective retrieval path and better preserves positional and spatial structure. The design uses two states: Visual-Dominant States for visual patch topology, and Recall-Oriented States for longer-range semantic dependencies. During decoding, a query-conditioned retrieval module reactivates state information when it becomes relevant. The distinction from standard KV pruning is important: the method changes the representation of evicted information rather than only changing the eviction ratio.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content reports evaluations on multimodal benchmarks with reductions in memory and computation, and positions the gains around VQA-style cases with delayed visual dependencies. The available text does not include the full result tables, so exact numbers should not be inferred. The key evidence to inspect is accuracy under fixed cache budgets, degradation as visual-token length grows, and the overhead of state updates and retrieval. The most informative ablations should isolate the entropy estimator, the dual-state design, and query-conditioned retrieval.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 minutes. Start with the Introduction, especially the empirical observations on deferred visual importance and visual continuity collapse. Then read the Method sections on entropy-guided retention, state transition, and dual-state retrieval. The main question is whether the state can preserve queryable information rather than merely smoothing discarded tokens. In the experiments, focus on performance-memory curves under different compression ratios and on long visual-context or multi-image settings. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most reusable part is the analysis of dynamic visual-token importance.

recommendation.zh: 明确指出多模态KV缓存的两个特有缺陷，仅需阅读§3方法设计部分即可
recommendation.en: Clearly identifies two unique defects of multimodal KV cache, only read §3 method design section

paper.title: CGC: Compositional Grounded Contrast for Fine-Grained Multi-Image Understanding
paper.abstract: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly, they still face notable challenges in fine-grained multi-image understanding, often exhibiting spatial hallucination, attention leakage, and failures in object constancy. In addition, existing approaches typically rely on expensive human annotations or large-scale chain-of-thought (CoT) data generation. We propose Compositional Grounded Contrast (abbr. CGC), a low-cost full framework for boosting fine-grained multi-image un

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型在细粒度多图像理解任务中存在的空间幻觉、注意力泄露、对象恒常性失效问题，同时避免依赖昂贵的人工标注或大规模CoT数据
summary.importance: 多模态对齐训练方向的小增量方法创新，提出低成本的多图像理解能力增强框架
summary.technical_approach: 基于现有单图像grounding标注，通过图像间对比和图像内对比构造组合多图像训练样本，在GRPO框架中引入基于规则的空间奖励，优化源图像归因、空间对齐能力
summary.experiments: 在细粒度多图像理解基准上验证，对比基线模型在空间定位、对象恒常性等指标上有提升，具体幅度未在摘要中完整披露
summary.authors_note: 作者来自杭州电子科技大学、理想汽车Base Model团队

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the problems of spatial hallucination, attention leakage, object constancy failure of MLLMs in fine-grained multi-image understanding, without relying on expensive human annotations or large-scale CoT data
summary_en.importance: Minor incremental method innovation in multimodal alignment training, proposing a low-cost framework for enhancing multi-image understanding capability
summary_en.technical_approach: Construct compositional multi-image training samples via inter-image and intra-image contrast based on existing single-image grounding annotations, introduce rule-based spatial reward in GRPO framework to optimize source image attribution and spatial alignment
summary_en.experiments: Validated on fine-grained multi-image understanding benchmarks, outperforms baselines on spatial localization and object constancy metrics, exact improvement margin is not fully disclosed in the abstract
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Hangzhou Dianzi University, Li Auto Base Model team

recommendation.zh: 属于多模态对齐训练的小增量改进，仅作为文献备查，不用读正文
recommendation.en: Minor incremental multimodal alignment work, only for literature reference, no need to read full text

paper.title: SSL-R1: Self-Supervised Visual Reinforcement Post-Training for Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated the great potential of enhancing the reasoning abilities in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, the reliance on language-centric priors and expensive manual annotations prevents MLLMs' intrinsic visual understanding and scalable reward designs. In this work, we introduce SSL-R1, a generic self-supervised RL framework that derives verifiable rewards directly from images. To this end, we revisit self-supervi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般意义上的“给 MLLM 再做一点 RL”，而是一个更具体的问题：现有多模态 RLVR 大多把奖励建立在文本答案是否正确上，视觉信号只是被压缩成少量语言线索来服务问答，因此模型容易学会语言侧的投机策略，却没有真正补强细粒度视觉表征、空间关系和局部一致性判断。另一条约束是数据成本。很多现有后训练方法依赖人工标注或外部模型打分，规模上不去，也会把奖励设计绑死在少数任务模板上。SSL-R1 的核心问题就是：能不能直接从图像本身构造可验证、可扩展、无需人工监督的奖励，让 RL 后训练真正作用在视觉理解能力上，而不是只强化语言输出习惯。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把视觉自监督任务从“预训练前置任务”改写成“RL 后训练奖励源”，这件事本身很有启发：奖励不一定来自人类偏好，也不一定来自任务标签，还可以来自输入本身的可逆变换和结构约束。第二，它给多模态 post-train 提供了一条更接近 pretrain 信号的路径。因为旋转、拼图、遮挡恢复、几何对应这些任务，本来就是视觉表征学习里最稳定的一类信号，把它们放进 RLVR 后，等于在后训练阶段重新注入视觉归纳偏置。第三，它说明 post-train 不只是“对齐输出格式”，也可以用来修正模态失衡。对当前很多语言强、视觉弱的 MLLM，这比继续堆 instruction tuning 更有针对性。贡献量级上，它更像一个方法范式和训练接口设计，而不是单点 benchmark 技巧。
summary.technical_approach:
方法的主线很清楚：把经典视觉 SSL 任务改写成 MLLM 可交互、答案可验证的视觉谜题，再用 GRPO 做 RLVR。论文选了五类任务，覆盖从全局语义到局部几何的不同粒度。1）Rotation prediction：对图像做离散角度旋转，让模型预测旋转角。这个任务最简单，但能测试全局结构感知和方向敏感性。2）Visual similarity：从同一图像裁出 reference 和 positive，再从其他图像裁出 negatives，构成多选题，让模型选最相似视图。它更接近实例判别，要求模型抓住语义和外观一致性，而不是只看局部纹理。3）Region inpainting：随机遮挡区域，让模型从候选中判断被遮挡内容或恢复相关属性。这个任务迫使模型利用上下文做局部补全。4）Patch ordering：打乱图像块顺序，让模型恢复正确排列，强调空间布局和对象部件关系。5）Geometric correspondence：构造跨视图或变换后的点/区域对应关系，要求模型判断几何匹配，针对更细的空间推理。

这些任务的共同点是：标签由图像变换过程自动生成，奖励函数可以精确判定对错，因此天然适合 RLVR。训练上，他们采用 reference policy 约束下的 GRPO，而不是 PPO。原因也直接：GRPO 不需要单独 critic，适合这类离散、可验证奖励场景；同时通过组内相对优势比较，能在同一 prompt 的多个候选回答之间形成稳定更新。论文的关键不是发明新的 RL 算法，而是把“视觉 SSL 任务设计”与“可验证奖励格式”对齐。另一个值得注意的点是任务形式被统一成 MLLM 可处理的问答接口，这意味着视觉强化不是通过额外视觉头单独训练，而是直接作用到现有多模态生成式模型的策略上。

从全文看，作者还做了比较细的任务设计研究，讨论什么样的 SSL 任务更适合 RL 后训练。一个隐含结论是：并不是所有自监督任务都同样有效。适合 RLVR 的任务需要同时满足三个条件：答案空间清晰、奖励判定稳定、与下游视觉能力有足够相关性。太低层、太模糊或过于依赖连续回归的任务，不容易转成高质量 RL 信号。
summary.experiments:
实验重点不是展示某一个 benchmark 的极限分数，而是证明这类自监督视觉奖励能系统性提升 vision-centric 能力。评测覆盖三类：细粒度感知、空间理解、组合式理解。论文在多个公开基准上都报告了提升，尤其是需要看清局部细节、理解相对位置、处理多对象关系的任务，增益更稳定。全文给出的结论很一致：SSL-R1 相比只做常规监督式 post-train 或语言中心 RLVR，更能改善视觉短板，而不是只提升回答风格。

更有价值的是消融。作者分别比较了不同 SSL 任务单独训练和组合训练的效果，发现任务之间存在互补性：rotation 这类全局任务成本低、收敛快，但上限有限；patch ordering 和 geometric correspondence 对空间理解帮助更直接；visual similarity 对细粒度辨别和鲁棒性更有利；region inpainting 更依赖上下文整合。组合训练通常优于单任务，说明视觉能力强化不能只靠一种 proxy。论文还分析了奖励设计、任务难度和训练稳定性的关系。难度太低，模型很快饱和，RL 信号变弱；难度太高，奖励过稀，优化不稳定。离散候选数、遮挡比例、旋转角粒度、负样本构造方式都会影响学习曲线。

从你给出的正文片段里，具体参数量、训练样本规模和每个 benchmark 的精确数字没有完整展开，因此这里不编造数值。精读时应重点核对实验章节中的：基座模型规模、RL 训练步数、每类 SSL puzzle 的数据构造规模、与 SFT 或其他 RLVR baseline 的绝对提升幅度，以及组合任务相对单任务的增益。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“问题定义 → 任务设计 → 消融”这条线读。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，确认作者批评的对象不是 RL 本身，而是语言中心奖励导致的视觉弱化。然后直接看 Method 里五个 puzzle 的定义，重点想三件事：标签是怎么自动生成的；奖励为什么可验证；这个任务到底在锻炼哪一种视觉能力。这里不要只看任务名字，要看 prompt 形式和答案空间，因为这决定了 RL 信号质量。

之后重点读实验里的 task ablation 和 reward/task difficulty 分析。这部分比总表更重要。真正值得深挖的是：哪些 SSL 任务迁移到多模态理解最有效，哪些任务虽然传统 SSL 常见，但放到 RL 后训练里收益有限；以及多任务混合时是否出现梯度冲突或能力偏置。如果你关心 pretrain-posttrain 接口，这篇最该看的点是它如何把“视觉自监督”从 encoder 预训练范式迁移到生成式 MLLM 的 policy optimization。预计精读时间 1.5 到 2 小时；如果只抓主线，读图 1、图 2、任务定义表、主结果表和关键消融，40 分钟左右可以建立完整判断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness in current multimodal RL with verifiable rewards: rewards are usually defined over textual correctness, while the visual input is only used to extract sparse cues for language reasoning. This creates a mismatch. Models may improve answer formatting and language-side reasoning, yet remain weak in fine-grained perception, spatial grounding, and local visual consistency. A second bottleneck is supervision cost: many post-training pipelines still rely on human annotations or external model judgments. SSL-R1 asks whether image-intrinsic, automatically verifiable signals can be turned into RL rewards so that post-training directly strengthens visual understanding rather than only reinforcing language behavior.
summary_en.importance: Its value is less about a single benchmark jump and more about opening a useful training interface. First, it reframes classical visual self-supervision as a reward source for RL post-training. That is an important shift: rewards do not have to come from preference labels or task annotations; they can come from structure-preserving transformations of the input itself. Second, it provides a post-training signal that is much closer to pretraining-style supervision. Rotation, patch ordering, inpainting, and geometric correspondence are stable visual learning signals; injecting them during RL effectively reintroduces visual inductive bias into MLLM post-training. Third, it shows that post-training can be used to correct modality imbalance, not just align output style. For language-dominant but vision-weak MLLMs, this is a more targeted intervention than more instruction tuning. The contribution is best read as a method and paradigm proposal for multimodal post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is conceptually simple and well aligned with RLVR. The authors take five standard self-supervised vision tasks and reformulate them as verifiable visual puzzles that an MLLM can answer in a text interface, then optimize the model with GRPO. The five tasks cover different granularities of visual reasoning. (1) Rotation prediction: the image is rotated by a sampled angle from a discrete set, and the model predicts the angle. This probes global structure and orientation sensitivity. (2) Visual similarity: two crops from the same image form a reference and a positive, while crops from other images serve as negatives; the model selects the most similar candidate. This resembles instance discrimination and requires semantic and appearance-level matching. (3) Region inpainting: a region is masked and the model must infer the missing content or choose the correct completion-related option, forcing contextual completion. (4) Patch ordering: shuffled patches must be reordered, emphasizing spatial layout and part-whole structure. (5) Geometric correspondence: the model reasons about point or region correspondences under transformations, targeting finer spatial reasoning.

These tasks share the properties that matter for RLVR: labels are generated automatically from the corruption or transformation process, and correctness can be checked exactly. The RL algorithm is GRPO rather than PPO. That choice is practical: no critic is needed, and relative comparison among sampled responses is well suited to discrete, verifiable reward settings. The main novelty is not a new RL optimizer, but the alignment between visual SSL task design and reward verifiability. Another important detail is that the tasks are cast into the native MLLM interaction format, so the visual reinforcement signal updates the generative policy directly instead of training a separate vision head.

A useful takeaway from the full method section is that not every SSL task is equally suitable for RL post-training. Good tasks need a clear answer space, stable reward computation, and meaningful transfer to downstream visual capabilities. Tasks that are too low-level, too ambiguous, or too dependent on continuous regression are harder to convert into high-quality RL signals.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story is about systematic gains in vision-centric capability rather than a narrow win on one benchmark. Evaluation spans fine-grained perception, spatial understanding, and compositional reasoning. The reported pattern is consistent: SSL-R1 improves multimodal understanding more reliably than language-centric RLVR or standard supervised post-training, especially on tasks that require local detail recognition, relative position reasoning, and multi-object relation understanding.

The ablations are the most informative part. The paper compares individual SSL tasks against multi-task combinations and shows clear complementarity. Rotation is cheap and converges quickly, but its ceiling is limited. Patch ordering and geometric correspondence help spatial reasoning more directly. Visual similarity is stronger for fine-grained discrimination and robustness. Region inpainting encourages contextual integration. Multi-task training usually outperforms single-task training, which suggests that no single proxy is sufficient to strengthen visual grounding broadly. The paper also studies reward design and task difficulty. If a puzzle is too easy, rewards saturate and the RL signal weakens; if it is too hard, rewards become too sparse and optimization becomes unstable. Candidate set size, masking ratio, rotation granularity, and negative sampling strategy all affect learning dynamics.

The excerpt provided here does not include the full numeric tables, so I will not invent exact values. When reading the full paper, the key numbers to verify are the base model size, RL training budget, data scale for each puzzle family, absolute gains over SFT and other RLVR baselines, and the margin between single-task and mixed-task training.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of problem framing, task construction, and ablation. Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to see that the target is not RL itself, but the language-centric reward design that leaves visual weaknesses untouched. Then go straight to the method section and inspect each puzzle carefully. For each one, ask three questions: how is the pseudo-label generated, why is the reward exactly verifiable, and what visual capability is actually being trained. The prompt format matters as much as the task name, because it determines reward quality and optimization stability.

After that, spend most of the time on task ablations and difficulty analyses rather than only the headline benchmark table. The most useful questions are: which SSL tasks transfer best to multimodal understanding, which classical SSL tasks become weak once converted into RL, and whether multi-task mixtures introduce conflicts or produce complementary gains. If your interest is the pretrain–posttrain interface, the key idea is how visual self-supervision is migrated from encoder pretraining into policy optimization for generative MLLMs. A careful read should take around 1.5–2 hours; a focused pass through Figures 1–2, the task definitions, the main results, and the ablations can give you the main judgment in about 40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得认真看，因为它在试一个更干净的方向：用视觉自监督任务直接造 RL 奖励；先盯 reward design 和 transfer，若迁移成立，内部应立刻复现一版。
recommendation.en: This is worth real attention because it tests a cleaner idea: deriving RL rewards directly from visual self-supervision; focus on reward design and transfer, and if the transfer is real, reproduce it internally.

Although recent latent reasoning paradigms internalize visual states to overcome these

paper.title: Chain-of-Thought Degrades Visual Spatial Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal Reasoning Models (MRMs) leveraging Chain-of-Thought (CoT) based thinking have revolutionized mathematical and logical problem-solving. However, we show that this paradigm struggles with generalized spatial intelligence. We perform a comprehensive evaluation of seventeen models across thirteen spatial benchmarks and identify a critical gap: CoT prompting consistently degrades performance in visual spatial reasoning. Furthermore, through a novel No-Image++ ablation, we demonstrate that

summary.core_problem: 多模态“推理模型”（通过SFT/RL学会长CoT）在数学/逻辑上常见收益，但在视觉空间推理上是否同样成立并不清楚。论文要回答两个问题：1) CoT提示或推理化后训练是否会系统性降低空间任务表现；2) 模型是否在空间题上依赖文本先验产生“无图也能答”的捷径与幻觉。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练研究的启发点很具体：把“长文本推理”当作通用能力注入，可能会牺牲视觉空间任务的可靠性，甚至强化基于语言先验的捷径。它对做RL后训练、数据配比和训练目标的人有现实意义：如果奖励/监督主要鼓励可读的文本推理轨迹，模型可能学到‘用语言编一个看似合理的空间解释’，而不是提升视觉表征上的几何操作能力。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上是系统评测与对照实验。
1) 模型组：17个模型，包含8个多模态推理模型（MRMs）与多种backbone MLM（含不同规模Qwen2.5-VL、InternVL、LLaVA，以及GPT-4o）。多数MRM基于同一Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct蒸馏/后训练，便于做“推理化是否伤害视觉空间”的同源对照。
2) 数据集组：13个空间基准，覆盖2D静态关系、3D几何、以及动态/时序一致性（如BLINK、CV-Bench2D/3D、MMVP、SpatialBench、3DSRBench、MindCube、OmniSpatial等）。
3) 统一评测协议：用VLMEvalKit统一系统提示与多选格式；pass@1 greedy；固定推理长度上限（max new tokens 32768）与上下文长度；3个seed。
4) CoT对照：同一模型在base prompt与CoT prompt（要求<think>…</think>再<answer>…</answer>）下对比，隔离“仅提示词引入CoT”的影响。
5) No-Image++：在不给图（空白图）的情况下加入“Cannot determine”选项，检验模型是否会因为文本先验而继续自信作答，从而量化shortcut learning与视觉幻觉。
summary.experiments:
1) CoT提示整体负效应：在多种MLM上，CoT prompting平均降低约3%准确率。
2) 推理模型不如其backbone：7/8个MRM未能超过其蒸馏来源的backbone，在“泛化空间基准”上出现系统性回退。
3) No-Image++揭示捷径：给空白图且提供“Cannot determine”时，推理模型仍会根据文本先验编造视觉细节并选择错误答案，表现出强幻觉与过度自信。
4) 评测设置细节：使用vLLM在4×A100上批量推理，bfloat16，batch size 16，3 seeds，greedy decoding。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含各数据集逐项分数表与显著性检验细节；若要更精确的“哪些基准跌得最多/哪些模型例外”，需要补充结果章节表格。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：先抓结论，再看对照设计是否严谨。
1) 先看Introduction与Figure 1/主结果表（若在正文后续）：确认“CoT平均-3%”与“MRM不如backbone”的统计口径。
2) 重点读Methodology里三件事：a) 统一prompt与MCQ格式是否会偏置某些模型；b) CoT prompt的具体模板；c) No-Image++如何构造空白图与“Cannot determine”选项，是否会引入新的分布外因素。
3) 再看分组结果：2D vs 3D/动态任务上负效应是否一致，这决定问题是“几何操作”还是“视觉证据使用”。
预计阅读时间：20-30分钟可把方法与主结论读清；若要复现或用于训练决策，需要把13个基准的细项结果与附录prompt逐条核对。

summary_en.core_problem: Reasoning-style multimodal models (post-trained with SFT/RL to produce long CoT) often help in math/logic, but it is unclear whether the same paradigm transfers to vision-centric spatial intelligence. The paper tests whether (1) CoT prompting and reasoning post-training systematically hurt visual-spatial benchmarks, and (2) models rely on textual priors to hallucinate spatial details even without images.
summary_en.importance: The takeaway for pretraining/post-training is operational: optimizing for verbose, text-first reasoning traces can reduce reliability on spatial tasks and amplify shortcut learning from language priors. This directly impacts RL/SFT objective design and data mixture decisions—rewarding “plausible explanations” may not train the underlying geometric/grounded operators needed for spatial reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
A controlled evaluation study.
1) Model suite: 17 models including 8 open-source multimodal reasoning models (MRMs) and multiple backbone MLMs (Qwen2.5-VL at 3B/7B/72B, InternVL variants, LLaVA variants, plus GPT-4o). Many MRMs share the same Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct backbone, enabling apples-to-apples comparisons.
2) Benchmarks: 13 spatial datasets spanning 2D static relations, 3D geometry, and dynamic/temporal consistency (e.g., BLINK, CV-Bench2D/3D, MMVP, SpatialBench, 3DSRBench, MindCube, OmniSpatial).
3) Standardized protocol: VLMEvalKit-style uniform prompting and MCQ formatting; pass@1 under greedy decoding; fixed inference settings (up to 32k tokens).
4) CoT ablation: evaluate each model with a base prompt vs a CoT prompt requiring <think> then <answer>, isolating the effect of prompting alone.
5) No-Image++: feed a blank image and include a “Cannot determine” option to measure shortcut reliance and hallucination when visual evidence is absent.
summary_en.experiments:
1) CoT prompting is net negative: across diverse MLMs, CoT reduces accuracy by ~3% on average.
2) Reasoning models regress vs their backbones: 7/8 MRMs fail to outperform the backbone they were distilled from on generalized spatial benchmarks.
3) No-Image++ exposes shortcut learning: with blank images and an explicit abstain option, MRMs still hallucinate visual details and confidently choose wrong answers based on textual priors.
4) Compute/eval details: vLLM on 4×A100, bfloat16, batch size 16, 3 seeds, greedy decoding.
(Note: the provided excerpt does not include the full per-dataset score tables; identifying which benchmarks/models drive the regressions requires the results section/appendix.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim with an eye for experimental control.
1) Start with the main results figure/table (and Figure 1 referenced) to confirm the averaging scheme behind “-3% with CoT” and the backbone-vs-MRM comparisons.
2) Read Methodology carefully: uniform prompt/MCQ formatting, the exact CoT template, and the No-Image++ construction (blank image + abstain option) to judge whether the ablation is fair.
3) Then check breakdowns by dataset category (2D vs 3D/dynamic) to infer whether the failure is about geometric operations or about using visual evidence at all.
Time: ~20–30 minutes for methods + headline results; longer if you need to reuse prompts or replicate the evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 别再默认“加 CoT 就更会推理”：这篇用 No-Image++ 把空间题的文本捷径暴露得很直白，优先看主表+无图消融。
recommendation.en: Don’t assume CoT is a free win: the No-Image++ ablation makes spatial-task shortcutting painfully obvious—read the main results table and the no-image section.
