paper.title: OmniTrace: A Unified Framework for Generation-Time Attribution in Omni-Modal LLMs

summary.core_problem: 在decoder-only的全模态自回归生成中，如何在“生成时”(per decoding step)把每段输出（token/短语/陈述）可靠地归因到输入中的跨模态证据单元（文本span、图像区域token段、音频/视频时间段token段），并解决现有归因方法在开放式生成场景下缺少固定target、因果图随解码增长、以及token级信号高噪声/碎片化导致解释不稳定与不可读的问题。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身（目标函数/数据/Tokenizer/Scaling）不是直接贡献，但对“可解释的多模态生成”与“训练/对齐阶段的可验证性”有现实价值：1) 提供一种与模型无关、无需重训的生成时归因协议，可作为多模态预训练/后训练的诊断工具（检查幻觉来源、跨模态依赖是否合理、对齐数据是否诱导错误依赖）；2) 把任意token级信号（attention/gradient等）统一转成语义span级解释，降低解释方差，利于构建更稳定的自动评测与数据过滤信号；3) 对后续若要做“归因约束的训练”(attribution regularization)或“基于证据的RL/RLAIF”提供了可插拔的观测接口。整体属于方法论/评测工具型贡献，启发大于直接提升SOTA。
summary.technical_approach:
OmniTrace将归因形式化为“沿因果解码过程的生成时追踪”(generation-time tracing)。设输入为跨模态交错token序列x，并预先定义可解释的source units集合S（每个source unit对应输入中连续token子段，如文本span、图像patch-token区间、音频/视频片段token区间）。在每个解码步t，假设可获得任意token级归因信号a_t(i)，表示输入token i 对生成token y_t 的影响（信号来源可为注意力权重、梯度/积分梯度、relevance propagation、或其他对齐分数）。核心在于一个统一的“token→source→span”的聚合协议：
1) 生成感知：归因以每个解码步为基本单位，而不是对固定logit/固定target文本做一次性解释；
2) 全模态统一：所有模态被嵌入到同一token时间线，归因在同一索引空间上计算，再映射回各模态source unit；
3) 语义span化：将高方差、碎片化的token级分数，按source unit聚合并进一步在输出侧形成可读的span级解释（论文强调“coherent span-level explanations”，目标是把零散token重要性变成陈述级/短语级可读证据）。
从全文可见其定位是“信号无关的后处理框架”：不发明新的归因信号，而是提供把不同信号标准化、对齐到source unit并在生成过程中稳定输出解释的协议与实现路径；并强调无需训练、可插拔到任意decoder-only omni-modal LLM。
summary.experiments: 论文在多任务、多模态基准上评估“生成时span级归因”的稳定性与可解释性，覆盖：多图推理Mantis-eval、图文交错摘要MMDialog与CliConSummation、音频推理与会议摘要MMAU与MISP、视频问答Video-MME，总计759个样例。结论性结果是：相较于naive self-attribution与embedding-based基线，OmniTrace在所有设置下给出更稳定、更语义连贯的归因（全文表述为“consistently produces more stable and semantically coherent explanations”）。但在你提供的全文片段中未出现可核验的具体数值指标（如稳定性度量、人工评审一致性、或定量提升幅度）、也未给出所用具体模型规模/参数量/解码设置等关键复现实验细节；因此无法在不臆测的前提下报告精确数字。若论文后文包含定量表格（Table 1及后续表/图），建议以其“span coherence / stability / human preference”等指标为主对比不同信号源与不同聚合策略的消融。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约20–30分钟）：
1) 重点看Introduction里对三大挑战的界定（generation-aware / omni-modal / semantically interpretable），这是框架设计的动机与评价标准；
2) 精看“OmniTrace”方法章节开头的形式化：输入token序列、source units S 的定义、以及每步归因信号a_t的抽象化假设——这决定了它为何能“model-agnostic”；
3) 直接跳到实验设置的Table 1（文中提到）与各任务案例可视化（若后文有），理解它如何把token分数变成跨模态span解释；
4) 若你关心对预训练/数据的启发：重点思考如何把OmniTrace输出用作数据过滤（剔除无证据生成）、或用作训练时正则（鼓励输出依赖正确模态证据），以及它对不同tokenizer/多模态tokenization粒度（patch大小、音频帧token等）可能带来的解释偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: How to perform faithful, generation-time attribution for decoder-only omni-modal LLMs: for each generated token/span/statement in open-ended autoregressive decoding, identify which heterogeneous input evidence units (text spans, image-region token blocks, audio/video temporal token segments) support it—despite the absence of a fixed target, the ever-growing causal decoding graph, and the high-variance, fragmented nature of token-level attribution signals.
summary_en.importance: Not a direct pretraining/scaling/tokenizer contribution, but a practically useful diagnostic and evaluation layer for multimodal foundation models. OmniTrace can (i) audit grounding and hallucination sources during multimodal generation without retraining, (ii) standardize diverse token-level signals into more readable span-level evidence, enabling more stable automatic evaluation and potentially data filtering, and (iii) serve as an interface for future training objectives that regularize or reward evidence-grounded generation (e.g., attribution-aware RL/verification). Overall, it is a tooling/framework contribution with downstream research leverage rather than an SOTA-training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: OmniTrace reframes attribution as generation-time tracing along the causal decoding process. The input is an interleaved omni-modal token sequence x, with a predefined set of interpretable source units S (each a contiguous token subset corresponding to a text span, image region token block, or audio/video segment). At each decoding step t, the method assumes access to an arbitrary token-level attribution signal a_t(i) measuring the influence of input token i on the next generated token y_t (attention-based, gradient-based, relevance propagation, etc.). The key contribution is a unified, model-agnostic protocol that maps noisy token-level scores to (1) source-unit level attributions across modalities and (2) semantically coherent span-level explanations aligned with the generated output, explicitly designed for open-ended autoregressive generation rather than fixed-target classification/extraction. The framework emphasizes plug-and-play integration and decoding-time operation, focusing on aggregation/normalization and cross-modal coherence rather than inventing a new base attribution signal.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across a heterogeneous benchmark suite totaling 759 examples: multi-image reasoning (Mantis-eval), interleaved image–text summarization (MMDialog, CliConSummation), audio reasoning/meeting summarization (MMAU, MISP), and video QA (Video-MME). The paper reports that generation-time span-level attribution is consistently more stable and semantically coherent than naive self-attribution and embedding-based baselines across settings. In the provided full-text excerpt, however, concrete quantitative metrics, model sizes, and exact numerical gains are not visible, so precise numbers cannot be cited here without speculating; consult Table 1 and subsequent result tables/figures for the actual deltas and any ablations over signal types and aggregation choices.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim plan (20–30 minutes): (1) Read the Introduction’s three challenges (generation-aware, omni-modal, semantically interpretable) to understand the design targets. (2) Read the formalization at the start of the OmniTrace section: definition of source units S and the abstract attribution signal a_t—this is the core “model-agnostic” contract. (3) Jump to Table 1 and qualitative visualizations/case studies (if present) to see how token scores become cross-modal spans. (4) If you care about foundation-model training, think about how OmniTrace outputs could be used for data filtering, grounding regularization, or diagnosing multimodal tokenization granularity effects.

recommendation.zh: 把碎片化token归因收敛成跨模态span级解释，适合作为训练/对齐诊断工具；只看方法管线与稳定性实验，别指望带来预训练配方增益。
recommendation.en: Useful as a model-agnostic debugging hook: it turns noisy token attributions into readable cross-modal spans; skim the pipeline + stability evals, don’t expect pretraining-recipe insights.

paper.title: Indexing Multimodal Language Models for Large-scale Image Retrieval

summary.core_problem: 探索多模态大模型在无需训练的情况下，能否作为图像-图像相似度估计器用于大规模实例级图像检索，并解决其在检索流水线中的可扩展性问题。
summary.importance: 贡献在“把 MLLM 的 next-token 概率转成相似度信号”的训练无关用法与检索系统集成；对理解多模态预训练表征的可迁移性有启发，但整体更偏检索/系统评测，非预训练方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 用成对图像提示 MLLM，将生成的 next-token 概率映射为相似度分数，实现 zero-shot 重排序；结合内存高效索引与 top-k 候选重排以适配大规模检索；并分析在外观剧变等条件下的失效模式。
summary.experiments: 在多个图像检索基准上做大规模重排实验，声称在“非原生域”上优于任务特定 re-ranker，且对遮挡/杂乱/小目标更鲁棒；摘要未给出所用 MLLM 名称、索引规模、以及具体提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: Test whether multimodal LLMs can serve as training-free image-to-image similarity estimators for large-scale instance retrieval, and how to make this scalable in retrieval pipelines.
summary_en.importance: Shows a training-free way to extract similarity from MLLM token probabilities and integrate it with indexing + reranking; insightful for transferability of multimodal pretraining, but mainly a retrieval/system study rather than pretraining innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Prompt an MLLM with paired images and convert next-token probabilities into similarity scores for zero-shot reranking; combine with memory-efficient indexing and top-k candidate reranking; analyze failure modes under severe appearance changes.
summary_en.experiments: Runs reranking on multiple retrieval benchmarks; claims better robustness to clutter/occlusion/small objects and out-of-domain gains over task-specific rerankers; the abstract omits the exact MLLM, scale, and numeric improvements.

recommendation.zh: 把MLLM的next-token概率硬转成图像相似度做检索，更多是系统工程而非表征洞见；知道这条“零训练检索”路线即可，读方法概览和规模/延迟曲线。
recommendation.en: Mostly a systems trick: repurposing next-token likelihood as an image similarity signal for retrieval; worth knowing the zero-training pipeline, skim the method overview + scaling/latency plots.

paper.title: MAny: Merge Anything for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning

summary.core_problem: 多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）中，如何缓解跨任务顺序学习导致的灾难性遗忘，尤其是同时发生的“感知对齐漂移”和“推理能力坍塌”。
summary.importance: 方法贡献（偏后训练/持续学习）：提出将任务知识以“可合并”的形式在跨模态投影与LoRA参数空间中融合，强调双重遗忘现象；对多模态模型持续学习与参数合并范式有一定启发，但对纯文本基座预训练相关性中等。
summary.technical_approach: MAny框架包含两部分：CPM（Cross-modal Projection Merging）在跨模态投影空间用视觉原型引导自适应合并以恢复感知对齐；LPM（Low-rank Parameter Merging）在低秩适配参数空间合并以减少任务间干扰，避免推理侧遗忘。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确模型规模、数据集名称与量化提升幅度；宣称在持续指令微调场景下缓解遗忘并提升推理与感知对齐的保持性。缺少可核验的SOTA/增益细节（需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in multimodal continual instruction tuning, including both perceptual alignment drift and reasoning collapse across sequential tasks.
summary_en.importance: Method contribution in continual learning/post-training: proposes a merge-based framework across projection space and LoRA space, highlighting a dual-forgetting phenomenon; moderately relevant to foundation researchers, more so for MLLM continual adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAny combines CPM (cross-modal projection merging guided by visual prototypes to recover perceptual alignment) and LPM (low-rank parameter merging to reduce inter-task interference and preserve reasoning).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or concrete gains; claims improved retention of perception alignment and reasoning under continual instruction tuning. Requires full paper for quantitative validation.

recommendation.zh: 持续指令调优里把“感知对齐漂移”和“推理坍塌”分开讲是个好提醒，但方法偏LoRA/合并技巧、外推到基座预训有限；只看遗忘分解实验。
recommendation.en: Good reminder to separate perceptual-alignment drift from reasoning collapse in continual tuning, but the solution is mostly LoRA/merge craft with limited pretraining impact; skim the forgetting decomposition.

paper.title: Does Visual Token Pruning Improve Calibration? An Empirical Study on Confidence in MLLMs

summary.core_problem: 评估多模态LLM中视觉token剪枝（推理加速）对模型校准/置信度可靠性的影响，而不仅是准确率。
summary.importance: 属于推理效率策略的可靠性评测与经验规律总结；对部署与评估体系有价值，但对预训练方法论影响间接。
summary.technical_approach: 在不同token预算下，对多种剪枝策略（SCOPE不同saliency权重、saliency-only、FastV、random）进行系统对比，使用ECE、Brier、AURC等校准指标分析“效率-可靠性-准确率”关系，并做内部alpha sweep研究saliency权重对校准的影响。
summary.experiments: 基于LLaVA-1.5-7B，在POPE与ScienceQA-IMG上评测；发现剪枝并非简单牺牲可靠性换效率：在POPE上SCOPE的pure-coverage设置可显著降低ECE且准确率接近不剪枝；alpha-sweep显示降低saliency权重在各token预算下持续改善校准，准确率变化较小（摘要未给出完整数值表）。

summary_en.core_problem: Study how visual token pruning (for efficient inference) affects calibration/reliability in multimodal LLMs beyond task accuracy.
summary_en.importance: An empirical reliability evaluation of inference-efficiency techniques; useful for deployment and evaluation methodology, with indirect relevance to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Systematically compare pruning strategies (SCOPE with varying saliency weights, saliency-only, FastV, random) across token budgets using calibration metrics (ECE, Brier score, AURC), including an alpha sweep to analyze the effect of saliency weighting.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluate LLaVA-1.5-7B on POPE and ScienceQA-IMG; pruning is not a simple reliability-efficiency tradeoff: on POPE, SCOPE pure-coverage yields substantially lower ECE with similar accuracy; lowering saliency weight consistently improves calibration across budgets with minor accuracy changes (full numbers not in abstract).

recommendation.zh: 告诉你剪视觉token可能把校准搞坏/搞好但不提供可泛化机制，更多是评测提醒；扫一眼结论图和分任务分解即可。
recommendation.en: Mostly an evaluation warning that pruning can shift calibration in non-obvious ways without a unifying mechanism; glance at the headline plots and per-task breakdown.

paper.title: Why and When Visual Token Pruning Fails? A Study on Relevant Visual Information Shift in MLLMs Decoding

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题是：现有多模态大模型（MLLM）视觉token剪枝方法在“简单视觉理解(VQA)”上看似可靠，但在“复杂视觉推理(以视觉数学推理VMR为代表)”上出现断崖式退化；作者基于全文分析指出根因并非剪枝策略本身“找不到相关token”，而是相关视觉信息在解码过程中会随推理步骤发生迁移（Relevant Visual Information Shift, RVIS），导致“prefill阶段一次性确定并永久丢弃token”的范式在推理任务上系统性失效。
summary.importance: 对预训练/基础模型研究的启发主要在两点：1）把“推理时动态证据需求”明确为一种可观测的解码期现象（RVIS），从机制层面解释了为何很多训练无关/一次性压缩（token pruning、静态稀疏化）在复杂推理上不稳；2）提出一种训练free的解码期自适应token管理范式（Detect-and-Swap），提示未来在多模态预训练与长链路推理中，可能需要把“证据检索/视觉token预算分配”建模为随解码演化的过程，而不是静态前处理。这对后续做多模态预训练时的目标设计（例如让模型学会在解码期显式移动注意/检索）与数据构造（多步推理需要跨区域证据）都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
全文方法论分两部分：
(1) 失败机理诊断：作者对比prefill阶段与若干关键decoding step的视觉注意力热力图，发现VQA任务注意力相对静态，而VMR中注意力会随推理步骤频繁跳转到不同图像区域；据此定义RVIS，并进一步用“RVIS发生频率/强度”与性能退化建立关联，论证RVIS是剪枝失败的主驱动。
(2) DSTP框架（Decoding-stage Shift-aware Token Pruning）：作为对现有剪枝器（如FastV、DivPrune）的训练free外挂。核心是保留被剪掉的token以备回收，并在解码期做两件事：
- RISD（Relevant Visual Information Shift Detect）：在线监控解码期视觉注意力分布变化，用阈值规则检测是否发生RVIS（即当前解码步模型的视觉关注与先前保留token集合不一致/发生显著漂移）。
- CPTS（Context-Preserving Visual Token Swap）：一旦检测到RVIS，就从“已丢弃token池”中取回当前步更相关的token，并与当前保留token进行交换/替换；同时强调“context-preserving”，避免粗暴插入导致上下文不稳定（论文表述为swap以减少错误生成）。
整体上，DSTP不改变模型参数、不需要再训练，目标是在尽量保留剪枝加速收益的同时，补上复杂推理中‘证据需求随步迁移’带来的信息缺口。
summary.experiments:
论文在两类任务上对比：
- 简单视觉理解：ScienceQA、GQA、TextVQA等VQA基准；结论是现有剪枝方法在这些任务上基本能维持接近原模型的表现。
- 复杂视觉推理：MathVerse、WeMath、DynaMath等视觉数学推理（VMR）基准；结论是FastV、DivPrune等在VMR上出现显著性能下滑（全文用“precipitous drops/断崖式下降”描述），且退化与RVIS频率正相关。
在此基础上，加入DSTP后：在VMR上显著缓解退化，同时在VQA上保持或略优；并强调额外开销很小、总体仍保留剪枝带来的效率收益。
注意：你提供的全文片段未包含完整表格数字（如各benchmark具体分数、token保留比例、加速倍数、阈值设置等），因此无法在不臆测的情况下给出精确提升幅度/具体数值；若补充论文PDF中的实验表（通常在Experiments/Appendix），我可以把关键数字逐项补齐。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（预计20–30分钟抓住要点）：
1）先看引言中对VQA vs VMR差异的定义，以及作者为何选择视觉数学推理作为代表任务（通常附录0.A也值得扫一眼）。
2）重点看Sec.3的诊断分析：prefill与decoding阶段注意力可视化对比、RVIS定义、以及“RVIS频率↑→性能↓”的证据链（图(b)-(f)那组可视化是全文核心论点）。
3）方法部分只需抓住DSTP的Detect-and-Swap：RISD如何判定shift、CPTS如何swap以及为何能保持上下文稳定。
4）实验部分优先看：VMR上的恢复幅度、不同剪枝器（FastV/DivPrune）+DSTP的通用性、以及效率/开销对比（token数、延迟、吞吐）。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a systematic generalization failure of visual token pruning in MLLMs: pruning methods that work well on straightforward VQA degrade sharply on complex visual reasoning (visual math reasoning as the main proxy). From full-paper analysis, the authors argue the root cause is not merely imperfect relevance scoring at prefill, but a decoding-time phenomenon—Relevant Visual Information Shift (RVIS)—where the visual evidence required by the model changes across reasoning steps, making one-shot prefill pruning fundamentally mismatched to multi-step reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Key takeaways for foundation-model/pretraining researchers: (1) RVIS is framed as an observable decoding-time mechanism explaining why static compression/sparsification (prefill-only pruning) can be brittle on reasoning-heavy multimodal tasks; (2) it suggests a broader design principle: multimodal “evidence budgeting” should be adaptive over decoding, which has implications for pretraining objectives, data design for multi-step reasoning (cross-region evidence), and future architectures that integrate retrieval-like token management rather than fixed front-end pruning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work combines diagnosis + a training-free fix.
Diagnosis: the authors compare visual attention maps between prefill and multiple decoding steps. VQA shows relatively stable focus, while visual reasoning exhibits frequent attention jumps to different image regions. They define this as RVIS and empirically link higher RVIS frequency to larger performance drops under pruning.
Method (DSTP: Decoding-stage Shift-aware Token Pruning): a plug-in wrapper over existing pruners (e.g., FastV, DivPrune). It keeps the pruned-away tokens in a cache for potential recovery, and during decoding performs:
- RISD (shift detection): monitors decoding-time visual attention and triggers when attention distribution indicates a shift in relevant regions (threshold-based).
- CPTS (Context-Preserving Token Swap): when RVIS is detected, it swaps currently kept visual tokens with newly relevant ones retrieved from the discarded pool, aiming to restore missing evidence while keeping the context stable.
No retraining, no parameter updates; the goal is to preserve most pruning efficiency while preventing reasoning-step evidence mismatch.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluation spans (i) VQA benchmarks (ScienceQA, GQA, TextVQA) where prior pruning largely preserves baseline quality, and (ii) visual math reasoning benchmarks (MathVerse, WeMath, DynaMath) where prior pruning shows steep degradation. Adding DSTP substantially mitigates the degradation on VMR while maintaining (or slightly improving) VQA performance, with minimal additional overhead so most efficiency gains remain.
Caveat: the provided full-text excerpt does not include the main result tables (exact scores, token budgets, speedups, thresholds), so I cannot report precise numeric deltas without the missing pages/appendix tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
1) Read the intro framing of VQA vs VMR and why prefill-only pruning implicitly assumes static relevance.
2) Focus on the diagnostic section with attention visualizations across decoding steps—the RVIS definition and the evidence that RVIS frequency correlates with pruning failure is the core contribution.
3) For DSTP, understand only the Detect-and-Swap loop (RISD trigger + CPTS swap) and what is cached.
4) In experiments, prioritize VMR recovery results across different pruners/models and the efficiency/overhead comparison (token counts/latency/throughput).

recommendation.zh: RVIS 把“相关证据会随解码迁移”钉死为机制现象，解释静态剪枝为何在推理崩；建议看现象曲线与 Detect-and-Swap，别纠结细节。
recommendation.en: RVIS nails down a mechanism—relevant evidence shifts during decoding—explaining why static pruning collapses on reasoning; read the phenomenon plots and Detect-and-Swap, skip minutiae.

paper.title: Boosting Visual Instruction Tuning with Self-Supervised Guidance

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态指令微调（visual instruction tuning）中“语言捷径”导致的视觉信息利用不足：即便视觉编码器很强，LLM 在解码时仍倾向依赖语言先验，从而在计数、空间关系、几何等视觉中心任务上失效；论文要回答的是如何在不改架构、不加复杂损失/RL 的情况下，让训练分布本身“强迫”模型用视觉证据。
summary.importance: 对预训练/数据科学的启发点很直接：通过“把自监督视觉任务改写成指令数据”来改变监督分布，而不是改模型或加 auxiliary loss。这是一种低成本的数据配比/课程学习手段：用少量（3%–10%）天然视觉落地的样本，抑制语言主导策略，提升视觉推理泛化。对后续研究（RL pretrain/RLVR 之外的可验证监督注入、指令数据构造、视觉token利用率诊断）有较强可迁移性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把经典视觉自监督 pretext task 变成标准 MLLM 可吃的 image–instruction–response 三元组，并直接混入指令微调：
1) 任务选择原则：答案不能从语言先验推断，必须依赖图像（vision-forcing）。
2) 任务改写：例如 rotation prediction、color matching、cross-view correspondence 等，通过对图像做可控变换/视角采样/对应关系构造，把“预测旋转角/匹配颜色/判断两视图对应”表述为自然语言指令与文本输出。
3) 训练范式：不引入额外损失、不做多阶段 pre/post 训练，也不走 RLVR；仍用自回归交叉熵，只改变 instruction tuning 的数据分布（在“模态竞争”视角下，用视觉必需任务对冲语言捷径）。
4) 关键经验结论：SSL 指令最有效的用法是“直接混在 instruction tuning 里”，而不是单独作为预训练或后训练阶段；甚至单图多视图采样也能带来收益，暗示关键在目标属性而非数据规模。
summary.experiments:
全文报告的核心实验结论包括：
- 只需在指令微调数据中注入小比例视觉自监督指令（约3%–10%），即可在多种视觉中心 benchmark 上获得稳定提升（计数、空间/几何等）。
- 覆盖多个 MLLM backbone 与训练设置，且对更强模型（如 LLaVA-OneVision-1.5）也能泛化。
- 通过“匹配训练迭代/计算量”的对照实验，排除收益仅来自更多训练步数。
- 对比不同注入方式：混入式优于作为独立阶段，支持其“监督分布塑形”假设。（论文片段未给出具体数值表格；若需精确提升幅度/各基准分数，需要对照正文实验表。）
summary.reading_guide:
建议泛读（45–60分钟）：
1) Introduction：抓住问题诊断——不是 encoder 弱，而是 instruction tuning 诱发语言捷径与视觉利用不足。
2) Method：重点看如何把 rotation/color/correspondence 变成自然语言指令三元组，以及混入比例与采样策略。
3) Experiments：优先看“不同注入比例”“匹配计算量对照”“混入 vs 分阶段”的消融，这三块最能支撑核心论点。
4) 讨论部分：关注其对训练动态/模态竞争的解释，思考如何迁移到视频、多模态长上下文或更强对齐阶段。

summary_en.core_problem: Address the under-utilization of visual evidence during visual instruction tuning: many MLLM instruction examples are solvable via language priors, so the decoder learns language-dominant shortcuts and fails on vision-centric reasoning (counting, spatial/geometric relations) even with strong vision encoders.
summary_en.importance: A data-centric intervention with high leverage: instead of architectural changes, auxiliary losses, or RLVR, it reshapes the instruction-tuning distribution by injecting a small fraction of inherently vision-grounded self-supervised tasks. This is directly relevant to pretraining/data scaling practice (mixture design, curriculum, grounding-forcing objectives) and offers a cheap knob (3–10% mix) to improve visual reasoning and generalization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Reformulate classic SSL pretext tasks into natural-language instruction triplets and mix them into standard autoregressive instruction tuning:
- Vision-forcing task design: answers are not inferable from text priors (e.g., predicting rotation, matching colors, cross-view correspondence).
- Triplet construction: apply controlled image transformations or multi-view sampling to generate automatic supervision, then express the task as (image, instruction, response) compatible with LLaVA-style pipelines.
- Training: unchanged optimization (cross-entropy next-token prediction), no extra stages; the only change is the task mixture during instruction tuning, motivated as counteracting “modality competition” where language shortcuts dominate.
- Key claim: mixing SSL instructions directly into instruction tuning is more effective than pre-/post- applying them; even single-image multi-view SSL can help, suggesting objective properties matter more than dataset scale.
summary_en.experiments:
Main reported findings:
- Injecting a small portion of SSL-style visual instructions (~3%–10%) consistently improves vision-centric benchmarks (counting/spatial/geometric reasoning).
- Works across multiple backbones/training regimes and transfers to stronger models (e.g., LLaVA-OneVision-1.5).
- Compute-matched controls indicate gains are not simply from extra training iterations.
- Ablations suggest “mixed-in during instruction tuning” > “separate stage”. (The provided excerpt does not include the exact numeric tables; precise deltas require reading the experiment section tables/figures.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim (45–60 min):
- Intro for the diagnosis (shortcut learning during instruction tuning).
- Method for the exact triplet formulations of rotation/color/correspondence and the mixing ratios.
- Experiments: focus on mixture-ratio sweeps, compute-matched controls, and mixed-vs-staged ablations.
- Discussion for implications on training dynamics and how to extend to video/long-context multimodal settings.

recommendation.zh: 把自监督视觉任务改写成指令样本来“逼模型看图”这招很便宜，建议只看数据配比与失败案例；若你在做 VIT 数据工程，可立刻复现 3–10% 注入的 ablation。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the cheap data-distribution hack (rewrite self-supervised vision tasks into instructions); focus on mixing ratios + failure cases, and replicate the 3–10% injection ablation if you run VIT pipelines.

paper.title: All in One: A Unified Synthetic Data Pipeline for Multimodal Video Understanding

summary.core_problem: 视频多模态理解训练缺少大规模、跨任务一致标注数据；真实数据采集与标注成本高且覆盖不足。
summary.importance: 数据合成用于训练的工作：对MLLM/Video-LLM后训练数据工程有参考价值，但更偏应用型数据管线，方法论突破有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出统一的合成视频数据生成管线，可在单一框架内生成多任务格式监督（计数/QA/分割等）；并引入VQA式微调策略，用结构化问题驱动视觉对齐与推理，而非仅依赖caption/简单指令。
summary.experiments: 在三个视频理解任务上评测（摘要未给出任务名称、模型规模、合成数据规模、基线与提升幅度细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal video understanding needs large-scale, richly annotated, multi-task data, but real-world collection/annotation is expensive and limited in coverage.
summary_en.importance: A synthetic-data-for-training pipeline relevant to Video-MLLM post-training data engineering, though it appears more incremental than paradigm-shifting.
summary_en.technical_approach: An all-in-one synthetic video data generation pipeline supporting multiple supervision formats (counting/QA/segmentation, etc.), plus a VQA-style fine-tuning strategy using structured questions to encourage grounding and reasoning beyond captions/simple instructions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three challenging video understanding tasks, but the abstract omits model scale, synthetic data scale, baselines, and quantified gains.

recommendation.zh: 统一视频合成数据管线对落地有用，但研究新意不多；当作数据配方库，挑你关心的任务看生成模板与质量控制即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as an implementation-oriented synthetic video data pipeline, not much new research-wise; treat it as a cookbook—inspect the task templates and QC steps you’d reuse.

paper.title: Script-a-Video: Deep Structured Audio-visual Captions via Factorized Streams and Relational Grounding

summary.core_problem: 现有视频字幕多为“单段落叙事”，把视觉动态、音频事件、实体身份与场景信息混写在同一文本流里，导致：①跨镜头的实体指代不稳定、重复描述多、易产生身份幻觉；②并发的视听事件缺少显式对齐，局部细节难以精修；③结构纠缠使得MLLM学习成本高，尤其小模型更难从自由文本中自行解耦关系。
summary.importance: 字幕不再只是描述终点，而是理解侧的“语义接口”（检索/推理证据）与生成侧的“可执行规格”（身份一致、多镜头可控、视听同步）的共同载体。若表示不具备可引用的结构与跨模态关系，理解会丢证据、生成会失控；因此需要一种既保真又可扩展、且对模型更可学习的脚本化表示。
summary.technical_approach:
提出MTSS（Multi-Stream Scene Script），用“流分解 + 关系落地”替代单段落字幕。
1) Stream Factorization：将视频拆成四条互补流——Reference流（持久实体/场景的引用库，提供稳定ID与外观锚点）、Shot流（时间有界的视觉镜头描述）、Event流（局部音频事件/语音等）、Global流（全局/环境上下文）。核心是把“持久不变的信息”与“随时间变化的信息”分离，减少冗余并支持局部更新。
2) Relational Grounding：用显式身份链接与时间链接把分解后的流重新编织成一致脚本。身份侧：中心化reference bank为人物/物体/场景分配持久标识，Shot/Event通过ID引用同一实体，避免跨镜头重述与指代漂移。时间侧：共享时间锚点对齐视觉片段与并发音频事件，并在描述内部用时间戳捕捉更细粒度对应（动作-台词-场景变化）。
整体效果：结构化脚本既能局部增补细节而不破坏全局叙事，又能保留视听对齐与实体一致性，从而提升理解与生成的可控性。
summary.experiments:
论文在理解与生成两端报告一致收益：
- 字幕/描述质量：在Video-SALMONN-2上Total Error Rate从0.5853降至0.5156；在UGC-VideoCap上audiovisual detail score从62.80升至71.54（相对Qwen3-Omni基线）。
- 推理能力：在Qwen3-Omni上Daily-Omni提升127%；WorldSense从0.1569升至0.3106，表明显式关系有助于恢复事件逻辑用于下游推断。
- 生成控制：用MTSS替代单段落prompt即可提升多镜头生成的人评指标：一致性1.22→1.77、视听对齐1.18→1.85、多镜头可控性1.00→1.71（即使不做架构适配）。
- 规模效应：结构化接口缩小小模型与大模型差距，暗示“表示更可学习”是关键来源之一。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 先看Introduction里对“单段落字幕三大结构缺陷”的动机与Figure 1（展示局部编辑/全局重写对比、以及小大模型差距缩小的直观结论）。
- 再看方法总览Figure 2（四流分解+关系落地的结构图）与Figure 3（脚本示例），把MTSS输出长什么样建立直觉。
- 最后快速扫实验段落中三类指标：captioning（TER/detail）、reasoning（Daily-Omni/WorldSense）、generation（人评三项）。

【must_read（精读）】
- 精读“Deep Structured Audio-visual Scripts”章节：逐字段理解四个stream各自承载的信息边界（哪些进Reference，哪些留给Global），以及timestamp/anchor如何定义。
- 重点核对Relational Grounding的两类链接：身份ID引用机制（跨Shot/Event一致性）与时间锚点（视听并发对齐 + 描述内细粒度时间戳）。建议对照Figure 2/3逐行读脚本示例，确认每条信息放在哪个stream、如何被引用。
- 关注论文声称的两条创新点是否在实验中被“可归因”验证：
  1) 分解带来的可编辑/可扩展性（局部更新不需全局改写）；
  2) 显式引用与时间对齐带来的身份一致与视听同步提升（尤其多镜头生成的人评提升）。
- 若时间有限，优先读：动机（Intro）→结构定义（方法章节+Figure 2/3）→三端实验结论（captioning/reasoning/generation）。
summary.authors_note: 作者主张“更好的字幕表示”本身就是提升MLLM理解与生成的关键杠杆：通过把信息拆成可引用、可对齐、可局部编辑的脚本结构，既降低学习难度（对小模型更明显），又把字幕从描述文本升级为可执行的控制接口。

summary_en.core_problem: Most video captions are written as a single free-form paragraph that entangles visual dynamics, audio events, entity identity, and scene context. This causes (i) ambiguous and inconsistent cross-shot references with redundant re-descriptions and identity hallucinations, (ii) weak explicit audio-visual alignment for concurrent events, making local refinement hard, and (iii) poor learnability for MLLMs—especially smaller models that must implicitly disentangle relations from dense text.
summary_en.importance: Captions are becoming a semantic interface: for understanding, they serve as structured evidence for retrieval and reasoning; for generation, they act as executable specifications for identity-consistent, temporally coherent, audio-visual synchronized synthesis. Without a modular, grounded representation, both fidelity (what happened) and controllability (how to generate it) degrade.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MTSS (Multi-Stream Scene Script) replaces monolithic captions with a grounded, editable scene-script built on two principles:
1) Stream Factorization: represent a video with four complementary streams—Reference (persistent entity/scene bank with stable IDs and appearance anchors), Shot (temporally bounded visual segments), Event (localized audio events/utterances), and Global (shared ambient context). This separates persistent information from time-varying content to reduce redundancy and enable local edits.
2) Relational Grounding: reconnect the factorized streams via explicit identity and temporal links. Identity grounding uses a centralized reference bank so Shot/Event entries can consistently refer to the same entities across shots. Temporal grounding aligns visual segments with concurrent audio events via shared anchors, and uses intra-description timestamps for finer action–speech–scene correspondences.
Net effect: a cohesive script that preserves cross-modal relations while remaining modular and scalable for refinement and downstream use.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported gains span captioning, reasoning, and generation:
- Captioning fidelity: on Video-SALMONN-2, Total Error Rate drops 0.5853→0.5156; on UGC-VideoCap, audiovisual detail score rises 62.80→71.54 (vs. Qwen3-Omni baseline).
- Reasoning: on Qwen3-Omni, Daily-Omni improves by 127%; WorldSense increases 0.1569→0.3106, suggesting explicit grounding helps recover event logic.
- Generation control: using MTSS as structured prompting improves multi-shot human ratings—consistency 1.22→1.77, audio-visual alignment 1.18→1.85, controllability 1.00→1.71—even before architectural adaptation.
- Scaling: MTSS narrows the small-vs-large MLLM gap, consistent with improved learnability from better-structured supervision/prompting.
summary_en.reading_guide:
【skim】
- Read the Introduction’s critique of monolithic captions and Figure 1 for the key intuition (local edits vs global rewrites; smaller-model benefits).
- Use Figure 2 (overall MTSS structure) and Figure 3 (script example) to quickly understand what the representation looks like.
- Skim the results focusing on three buckets: captioning (TER/detail), reasoning (Daily-Omni/WorldSense), and generation (human-rated multi-shot metrics).

【must_read】
- Deep-read “Deep Structured Audio-visual Scripts”: precisely learn the information boundary of each stream (what belongs in Reference vs Global, etc.) and how timestamps/anchors are defined.
- Study Relational Grounding in two parts: identity linking via persistent IDs across Shot/Event, and temporal alignment via shared anchors plus fine-grained timestamps. Read Figure 2/3 line-by-line against the text.
- Validate the two core claims against evidence: (i) factorization enables scalable/local refinement, and (ii) explicit identity+temporal grounding improves cross-shot consistency and audio-visual synchronization (especially in multi-shot generation metrics).
- If time is limited: Intro → MTSS definition (Figures 2/3) → the three result sections (captioning/reasoning/generation).
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s thesis is that representation design is a primary bottleneck: turning captions into a factorized, explicitly grounded script makes supervision/prompting more learnable (notably for smaller models) and upgrades captions from descriptive text to an executable control interface for joint audio-visual generation.

recommendation.zh: 结构化字幕表示有现实价值：建议只读表示分解设计与跨镜头指代一致性的消融，能直接启发你改数据格式而不是改模型。
recommendation.en: The factorized caption format is practically useful—read the representation design and the cross-shot coreference ablations; it suggests changing data format more than architecture.

paper.title: Audio-Omni: Extending Multi-modal Understanding to Versatile Audio Generation and Editing

summary.core_problem: 在统一框架中同时实现音频多模态理解、通用音频/音乐/语音的生成与编辑，并缓解音频编辑数据稀缺导致的能力缺口。
summary.importance: 多模态生成方向的重要系统化工作：提出“理解+生成+编辑”一体化端到端框架，并贡献大规模音频编辑数据集（>100万编辑对），对统一多模态生成范式与数据构建具有启发。
summary.technical_approach: Audio-Omni架构：用冻结的多模态LLM负责高层语义理解与推理/规划，用可训练的Diffusion Transformer负责高保真音频合成与编辑；通过构建AudioEdit大规模编辑对数据来支撑编辑能力学习与泛化到多域（sound/music/speech）。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出AudioEdit数据规模（>1M编辑对）；未给出具体模型参数量、训练数据总量、对比基线与量化提升幅度，仅描述在多域生成与编辑上进行广泛实验验证。

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary_en.core_problem: Building a unified system that combines multimodal audio understanding with versatile audio generation and editing across domains (sound, music, speech), while addressing the scarcity of supervised audio-editing data.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an end-to-end ‘understand–generate–edit’ framework and contributes a large-scale audio editing dataset (over one million edit pairs), offering a concrete path toward general-purpose audio editing and multimodal generative modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses a frozen multimodal LLM for high-level semantic understanding, reasoning, and planning, coupled with a trainable Diffusion Transformer for high-fidelity audio synthesis and editing; introduces the AudioEdit dataset to train editing behaviors and improve cross-domain generalization.
summary_en.experiments: Introduces AudioEdit with >1M editing pairs and reports broad validation across sound, music, and speech generation/editing tasks; the abstract omits model sizes, full training data details, baselines, and exact quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 想做音频多模态预训练就只需看数据与训练配方：>100万编辑对可能比模型结构更值钱，复现成本主要在数据管线。
recommendation.en: If you care about audio pretraining, focus on the dataset + training recipe: the 1M+ edit pairs are likely the real contribution; replication hinges on data pipeline, not architecture.

paper.title: LAST: Leveraging Tools as Hints to Enhance Spatial Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型（MLLM）在空间推理（几何布局、相对/绝对距离、尺度估计、拓扑关系）上常出现幻觉与不精确：仅靠数据规模与微调难以让模型内化几何先验与约束；而引入深度估计、分割、检测等专用视觉工具虽有潜力，却面临两大障碍——工具异构且参数繁多导致长链路调用不稳，以及工具输出（mask、depth map 等低层信号）难以被 MLLM 直接理解并转化为高层空间线索。
summary.importance: 空间推理是机器人导航、具身交互、3D 场景理解等落地场景的基础能力。论文通过实证指出：开源 MLLM 在高精度定位上与专用模型（如 GroundingDINO）存在显著差距，且简单 scaling 收益有限；因此“让 MLLM 学会用工具”比“让 MLLM 重新学会所有感知能力”更可行。该工作提供了工具抽象与训练范式，使 7B 级开源模型在多项空间推理基准上达到/超过强闭源模型，具有工程与研究双重价值。
summary.technical_approach:
LAST（Leveraging Tools as Hints）提出统一的工具增强空间推理框架，核心由两块组成：
1) LAST-Box 交互式沙盒：把异构视觉模型标准化为可组合的“原子指令（atomic instructions）”，并进一步封装为更高层的“空间技能（skills）”。技能层的目的有二：
  - 缩短工具调用的长时序链路（减少多步配置与误差累积）；
  - 将低层输出（分割 mask、深度图等）转译为模型可消费的文本/视觉提示（hints），让 MLLM 能把工具结果纳入推理。
2) Progressive curriculum-based training：采用渐进式训练，让模型先学会“理解工具输出语义”（tool-aware warm-up），再学习更复杂的指令跟随与多步工具调用，从而提升稳定性与泛化。
整体范式强调：工具不是外接黑盒答案，而是以“提示/线索”的形式进入推理链，促使模型在高层逻辑中显式利用几何与拓扑证据。
summary.experiments:
论文在四个数据集上评测。预分析给出两条关键观察：
- 观察1：在 grounding 子任务上，Qwen2.5-VL 系列即使从 3B 扩到 7B，在严格 IoU=0.7 下提升很小（+1.5%），仍显著落后 GroundingDINO（差距约 11.2%），说明仅靠 scaling 难补精细几何感知。
- 观察2：即便把工具输出直接做成提示，MLLM 也难以稳定识别并利用这些提示完成多类空间任务。
在完整实验中，LAST-7B 通过沙盒技能抽象 + 渐进训练，在复杂空间推理任务上相对 backbone 获得约 20% 的提升，并在若干基准上超过强闭源模型（论文摘要陈述）。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 读 Introduction：明确两大挑战（工具调用难、输出难理解）与 LAST 的总体解法。
- 看 Preliminary Analysis：两条观察直接说明“为什么需要工具增强而不是继续堆数据”。
- 快看方法总览：理解 atomic→skill 的抽象思想与 progressive training 的阶段划分。

【must_read（精读）】
- 精读 LAST-Box 设计：
  - 原子指令如何统一不同视觉工具的接口与参数空间；
  - skill 如何封装多步调用并把输出转成可解释 hints（这是减少长链路错误的关键创新点）。
- 精读 Progressive Tool-Aware Training：
  - warm-up 阶段具体让模型学什么（工具语义/输出解读），以及如何过渡到复杂工具调用与推理。
- 精读实验分解：
  - 对比“直接给工具提示” vs “LAST 训练后会用工具”；
  - 关注不同任务类型（相对方向/距离、绝对距离、尺度估计）上的增益差异，以判断技能抽象的泛化边界。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调空间推理的关键瓶颈在“精细感知 + 结构约束”的缺失：MLLM 既不擅长高精度定位，也不擅长把低层视觉信号转成可推理的几何线索。LAST 的贡献在于把工具使用从零散的 tool-calling 提升为可复用的技能层，并用课程学习让模型先理解工具语义再学会调用，从而在长链路、多任务空间推理中更稳健。

institutions: National Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University

summary_en.core_problem: MLLMs often hallucinate or are imprecise on spatial reasoning (geometric layouts, relative/absolute distances, size estimation, topological relations). Pure data scaling/fine-tuning struggles to internalize geometric priors and constraints. While leveraging specialized vision tools (depth, segmentation, grounding) is promising, it is hindered by (i) heterogeneous, parameter-rich tool invocation over long horizons, and (ii) low-level tool outputs (masks, depth maps) that MLLMs cannot readily interpret into high-level spatial cues.
summary_en.importance: Spatial reasoning is foundational for robotics navigation, embodied interaction, and 3D scene understanding. The paper empirically shows a persistent gap between open MLLMs and specialized models (e.g., GroundingDINO) at high-precision grounding, with limited gains from scaling. This motivates a tool-augmented paradigm where MLLMs learn to use mature perception tools rather than relearn them. LAST delivers an abstraction + training recipe that enables a 7B open model to achieve strong gains and compete with proprietary systems.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LAST (Leveraging Tools as Hints) is a unified framework for tool-augmented spatial reasoning:
1) LAST-Box interactive sandbox: standardizes heterogeneous vision models into composable atomic instructions, and further composes them into higher-level spatial skills. The skill layer (a) shortens long-horizon tool-calling trajectories to reduce error accumulation, and (b) encapsulates low-level outputs (segmentation masks, depth maps) into model-interpretable textual/visual hints.
2) Progressive curriculum-based training: a staged training paradigm with a tool-aware warm-up so the model first learns the semantics/interpretation of tool outputs, then learns more complex instruction following and multi-step tool usage.
A key design choice is treating tool outputs as “hints” integrated into reasoning, rather than opaque external answers.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on four datasets. The preliminary analysis highlights:
- Observation 1: On grounding, Qwen2.5-VL scaling from 3B to 7B yields small gains under strict IoU=0.7 (+1.5%), and still trails GroundingDINO by ~11.2%, indicating scaling alone is insufficient for precise geometric grounding.
- Observation 2: Even when tool outputs are provided as prompts, MLLMs struggle to consistently recognize and exploit them across diverse spatial tasks.
In full experiments, LAST-7B with skill abstraction + progressive training achieves ~20% gains over the backbone and outperforms strong closed-source LLMs on challenging spatial reasoning tasks (as stated in the abstract).
summary_en.reading_guide:
【skim】
- Read the Introduction to capture the two core challenges and the high-level solution.
- Read the Preliminary Analysis to understand why scaling and naive tool prompting are insufficient.
- Skim the method overview for the atomic→skill abstraction and the staged training idea.

【must_read】
- Deep-read LAST-Box:
  - How atomic instructions unify tool interfaces/parameters.
  - How skills package multi-step calls and translate outputs into interpretable hints (the key to reducing long-horizon failures).
- Deep-read Progressive Tool-Aware Training:
  - What the warm-up teaches (tool semantics/output interpretation) and how it transitions to complex tool invocation.
- Deep-read ablations:
  - “Direct tool hints” vs “LAST-trained tool usage”.
  - Gains by task type (relative direction/distance vs absolute distance vs size estimation) to understand generalization limits.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue the bottleneck in spatial reasoning is missing fine-grained perception and structured geometric constraints: MLLMs are weak at precise localization and at converting low-level signals into usable geometric evidence. LAST elevates ad-hoc tool calling into a reusable skill layer and uses curriculum learning so models first understand tool semantics before learning to invoke tools, improving robustness in long-horizon, multi-task spatial reasoning.
